If you're into the whole 'Kawaii-Ness' of japanese chibi characters, then this game is already worth it. Despite having gotten it during the summer 2014 steam sale, I would of easily bought this at its' full price, due to the fun and interest in the game.  The game itself is basically a form of board game where you have to complete tasks (normas) either by getting 'stars' (granted by either the end of a 'chapter' by defeating a CPU, Player, or Flash Enemy, or by landing on a bonus tile), or by getting wins (granted by defeating a CPU, Player, or Flash Enemy).  You're allowed to start of as four different characters (Sugure, QP, Kai, and Marc) and progress through their campaigns, which allows you to amass star points, which can then be used to unlock other characters which are unlocked for buying through the campaigns. Each character has a different specialty in terms of skills (Attack, Defense, and Evasion) and each have different hypers (Unique skills that attune to a specific character, an example being Marc's 16x Big Cannon, which damages a specific character in attunement with how many 'star levels' that Marc has.)  Overall, the game is filled with kawaii, board games, a little bit of friendly murderous rivalry, and a lot of fun.

Me ha gustado. Se nota el cariño y el gusto por la estética y la temática cyberpunk.  El diseño es una burrada de bueno, es espectacular que consigan tanto empaque en los escenarios con tan pocos voxels. Es realmente gratificante ver los escenarios y conducir entre edificios. Además la cámara se esfuerza en mostrarte los escenarios más detallados, aunque a veces tripea.  No busques mecánicas o puzles complejos, porque no los hay, es más bien una aventura de exploración mezclada con visual novel con una historia razonablemente bien escrita y bastante interesante, narrada a base de conversaciones que se dan de trabajo en trabajo.  Está lleno de personajes, a mi gusto, bastante interesantes.  Las conversaciones están muy pausadas, eso es cierto (creo que se puede quitar el delay entre frase y frase), pero he leído muchas críticas respecto al doblaje y honestamente, no las entiendo. No es esto el Cyberpunk 2077, pero las actuaciones no están mal. En ocasiones Rania dice cosas que yo no habría dicho, pero es mi mayor pega en este aspecto.  En cuanto a problemas que tiene el juego: El control es agradable, pero las colisiones con objetos son un poco raras y por la perspectiva es complicado prevenir golpes. Los ascensores son absurdos, más de la mitad de las veces no sabía a dónde iban a llevarme (le vendría bien un cambio de iconos que lo hiciese más evidente). En ocasiones la cámara fuera del HOVA falla bastante, y el control del personaje se invierte sin sentido. En la entrada de algunos sectores la cantidad de coches que te encuentras hace prácticamente imposible esquivarlos, aunque reconozco que da sensación de estar en un verdadero atasco.

Its unfortunate that software with a very small, very dedicated, and very hard working team come up with a solid beautiful product, but ultimately shoot themselves in the foot with lofty ambitions and an inability to prioritise.  It is a difficult product to review, as just with plenty of other games and various software or sim packages in the past, there is the demonstration product (which isnt what im reviewing here) and then there is the 'finished' product. Laminar have fallen into a newly created catch all (trap from a consumers perspective) of having a fantastically immersive and pretty demonstration product showing how well their ideas work, but then trip themselves up by releasing a 'commercial' product at a lofty $80 with a long list of features, the fully working parts of this sim, are fantastic, but are all of the same stock standard functions of any other flight simulator.  Laminar work very very hard on getting THEIR standard features of their flight sim working, and fastidiously update them as they work futher on the product... BUT......  The problem comes when you look at the list of features that are meant to be unique to X-Plane, and thats when you run into a long slew of inherently broken, unworked on, promised, or somewhat-working-low-priority-to-fix issues, that on enquiry are met with a slew of 'Well it IS just a pre-release beta version, of course there are going to be issues'   What you get for your $80 - is the Demonstration area which has been spit polished up the wazoo to make sure you get a feel for what the X-Plane world is meant to be, and a handful of beautifully detailed aircraft with 3d cockpits. However, its not just a plug in the joystick and go type sim. In this regard, its supposedly meant to be a little fiddly working out how to start this and switch on that, including working nav and com (debateable - ATC was an original 'selling point' feature from day one, that has remained inherently broken since day one) systems which add to wonderful immersion.  What its not meant to refer to, is having to fiddle around with background simulator options just to make an aircraft flyable in the first place (it took about an hour of googling various unrelated things to find a fix for utterly uncontrollable pitch flutter for instance) and often requires fiddling about when loading another aircraft. Thereby breaking the previously aforementioned immersion again.  There is a decent sized community providing plenty of aircraft, but these are fairly badly organised, and doing a general search for specific aircraft generally brings up masses of repaints of aircraft, and you WILL download plenty, but it will take a few error indications trying to open the aircraft in the game before you figure out that most of the files youve downloaded are only repaints of a stock aircraft you dont have, and is no longer available. One particular person has worked wonderfully hard on some fantastically detailed F-14s and F/A-18s for instance, but theyre all based off an airframe made in the in game tool, with little internal detail, and the external detail it does have, doesnt really mean much when the AI flying it lands by lining up a beautiful approach, shutting down engines about 50ft above the runway, then nosediving straight into the ground. (According to most of what i can find, this is either - completely normal/user fault for not creating routes for an aircraft theyre not going to fly/non existant (always followed by a video showing one of the demonstrator aircraft on a demonstrator airfield)/it IS beta you have to expect problems/your computer is too slow/youve got a third party mod not compatible with your ai) - Occhams Razor would say - games broke.  Easier to review the scenery outside of the demo areas or the hideously overpriced payware available - Its basically crap. The huge downloads for regional scenery are little more than big bump maps overlaid with ICAO points, overlaid with generic objects. Melbourne, for instance, has a 1.5km tall 'Eureka Tower' somewhere in the middle of hawthorn. (Thanks be to the crew behind VOZ  for fixing that, yet more third party freeware modders that work harder than the original developer - Melbourne actually has its bridges and biggest buildings in the right place)   Ultimately, unless Laminar want to drop the price to something far far far more reasonable, and make all base software for it part of the price. and ensure anyone that actually has paid the current price for this gets all updates and payware in future either free or a drastically reduced price, this really is not software that is close to being worth the price tag.  Excellent sim, but the price, the broken promised features, and the perpetual 'Beta status' excuse for anything outside of standard flight sim fare being broken combine to me absolutely regretting biting the bullet and paying for this.  I would highly advise downloading it first and seeing if what you intend to use it for is broken or not then go from there, but this certainly isnt worth a casual purchase with cheap hardware.

THIS IS NOT SKATE 4!!!  Alright now that that is out of the way, I think there is an excellent game in the works here.  I was skeptical when I saw the trailers, but bought the game anyway and I am amazed.  This sim is crisp and clean and brings a whole new way of thinking to the skateboarding genre.  Upon startup the game is quite difficult to learn (especially if you have all of the EA Skate controls engraved into your muscle memory like I do), but after you accept the two stick flick controls it becomes pretty intuitive if you understand the basics of how a skateboard works.  Pros: -Graphics are incredible, very cinematic and nice to look at especially with high graphics (wish my framerate was higher but oh well) -The map is awesome, not huge but there still is a lot to explore and many cool spots to skate -Replay editor is awesome, intuitive, and super helpful. There are many more pros, but I'll stick to these as well as the smooth gameplay and controls.  Cons: -STEERING, the steering with triggers is not fun but I understand it is necessary for the dual stick controls -Useless obstacles, stuff that isn't skateable and just gets in the way of what you want to hit. -Falling when you bump into anything  Over all I think the game is amazing so far and I'm looking forward to see where it goes from here, If I had the choice to change things I would say get rid of many of these useless obstacles; with steering being difficult as it is, having random stuff in the way of features makes it really annoying because I see a cool spot, but theres a giant concrete block or a tree in the way.  I would also add a drop in ramp of some kind into the world editor, just something I can place in front of a stair set or something else I want to hit.  One last thing is customization, I know this isn't top priority, but very few options to choose from (I'm sure more is on the way in this area), but I'm wondering if different board or wheel sizes actually make any kind of a difference to the mechanics.  If they do by all means keep them, but if not then please add more designs.  Over all very good game am excited to play more and see whats next!!!

I'm A huge fan of ninja gaiden like action games...Like I've been at the top of the leader boards in the ninja gaiden black(xbox) and sigma 2(ps3). That being said I love hack and slash games with a decent combat system. If you are the type of fan who is super into games like Bayonetta or Ninja giaden specifically for the combat then you might like this game. It has a simple time based/reflex based combat system where you simply combo enemies repeatdily and time your parries and counter attacks as you see them coming. The game rewards you for not getting hit by giving you charges for your holy attacks and red orbs when you kill enemies. All that being said I only recommend this game to pure action hack and slash enthusiast since this game is just basically you in a arena killing enemies in numerous waves until you get to the boss. There is no platforming or puzzles or any other basic extra type of game play you'd expect in a standard hack and slash game...just combat in a room/area. So far I've beaten 3 bosses. I've enjoyed the game for what it is and personally I think  Mitsurugi Kamui Hikae is better than DmC or ninja gaiden 3 despite it being a barebones and simple action game.

I Picked Dark Souls 2 up during the summer sale, and got it for a pretty good deal. So far I have had a blast jollily cooperating with my friends. Now you may be asking why I don't reccomend Dark Souls 2 even though all I've said is positive things so far. Well, the answer is a game breaking addition in the latest patch (1.08). This change has completely made one of the starting classes in the game useless. The class in question is the Cleric class (which of course I happened to pick). From Software has decided to nerf all lightning spear variations to a point of utter uselessness. This nerf has caused the ammount that you can carry to be greatly (a word I don't use lightly) reduced. By default with one lightning spear attuned I could carry 11 lightning spears. Now with two atttuned I can carry a whopping 6. Oh, and did I mention that they got their damage reduced? Całkowity restart serii, porzucenie wątków z poprzednich części na rzecz nowej fabuły, postaci i rzucenie historii widzianej oczami młodej, niedoświadczonej archeolog, która trafia na dziwną, pełną tajemnicy wyspę, która kręci się wokól historii Yamatai i królowej Himiko. Kolejny dowód na to, że Tomb Raider i Lara Croft stały się marką wartą bardzo wiele dla Square Enix i Crystal Dynamics.. Czy to w dalszym ciągu jest Tomb Raider? Myślę, że jest to bardzo dobry reboot serii, który ukazuje postać Lary Croft z nieco innej strony; tej wrażliwszej i niedoświadczonej. Historia wyspy jest przedstawiona w bardzo ciekawy sposób, choć mi osobiście niektóre lokacje nie przypadły do gustu, były nużące lub po prostu mało interesujące. Zawiodły mnie również wątki postaci pobocznych, które są strasznie małostkowe i uproszczone do tylko kilku dialogów, a reszta została upchana w notatkach, które walają się po całej wyspie. Zawodzą również naciągane sceny śmierci, w pewnych momentach po prostu wepchane na siłę, aby wywołać wzruszenie. Tylko czym mam się wzruszać? Postacią, którą ledwo co poznałem, a ona po prostu umiera? TR 2013 jako pierwszy doczekał się polskiego dubbingu, którym moim zdaniem został zrobiony świetnie, a Karolina Gorczyca idealnie pasuje do roli Lary. Mam nadzieję, że w przyszłej części również ją usłyszymy. Warto też wspomnieć o trybie multiplayerowym, którym jest dodatkiem do singla, nad którym wypadałoby jeszcze popracować (a tak się już nie stanie, co za pech). Lagi i bugi mogą tylko zniesmaczyć graczy mających pierwszy kontakt z TR 2013. Mimo to, nie żałuję czasu spędzonego w multi, choć przydałoby się dodać nowe tryby, i dać możliwość normalnego zakładania gry publicznej i ustawiania limitu zabitych czy czasu. Ilość map to też pomsta do nieba, a na mapach dlc nikt nie gra, bo albo ich nie ma, albo myśli tak jak ja. Podsumowując, gra jest bardzo dobra, polecam fanom gier akcji. Niektórzy mówią, że gra jest podobna do serii Uncharted, dostępnej na PS3. Nie wiem, ile w tym prawdy, bo nigdy nie miałem okazji zagrać.  Ocena: 9/10 Plusy: + bardzo dobry restart serii + brak poszukiwań matki w odmętach Avalonu + ładna grafika + pokazanie Lary z nieco innej strony + wciągający tryb multiplayer + polski dubbing  Minusy: - niezbyt rozległe wątki postaci ze statku - mimo wszystko zabugowany multiplayer - niektóre lokacje naprawdę nużą - wydanie dodatkowych map do multi w dlc  Dziękuję za uwagę i poświęcony czas.

Fallout 4 provides a multi-faceted platform that allows you to play in a massive post-apocalyptic world 200 (give or take a few decades adjusting for the Earth's spin and a few dings to the old chronometer) years after the bombs fell. The story line follows the sole survivor's quest to get his/her son back while exploring a brave new world and surviving the inherent dangers the Common Wealth (of Massachusetts) brings.  As I had mentioned before, the platform is multi-faceted in that you get an RPG, an FPS, a Settlement Builder and a limited SIMS-ulator with extensive weapons and armor builder. This translates into a game that plays like the previous Fallout but adds a level of crafting and settlement aspect not before experienced in this franchise. As was the case with Fallout 3, you are free to play the game as you fit.  You will start with the main quest arc but can easily divert to side missions or straight into settlement building.  Fallout 4 add-ons do a great job of adding valuable real estate for the game  with one massive storyline and two smaller but interesting storylines as well as support add ons that increase settlement and crafting for Fallout 4.

Saromost 2 – первый проект Amanita Design, появившийся в стиме и с которого эти классные ребята из Чехии начали свой полноценный путь к славе. Да, это не игра уровня Machinarium и Botanicula, но по духу она абсолютно такая же – добрая, милая, забавная и позитивная. Маленькое нечто, собранное на флэше с душой и любовью, к которому тяжело остаться равнодушным.  Сюжетно игра не представляет из себя практически ничего – это история о приключениях гномика в поисках своей собаки, которую украли пришельцы. Наш герой ни о чём не думая запрыгивает в свой космический корабль в виде банки из-под какого-то напитка и отправляется на другую планету чтобы спасти своего друга.   Геймплейно же это упрощённая версия классической Point&Click адвенчуры. Вся игра – сплошной набор экранчиков, на каждом из которых в большинстве случаев нужно просто закликать все точки в нужном порядке.  Инвентаря и игр с комбинациями водки и сапога здесь нет, так что о беготне с ворохом предметов можно забыть. Сложностью творения Amanita никогда не отличались, но второй Саморост очень прост даже на фоне полноценных творений студии. Застрять здесь просто невозможно.  Но главное, чем подкупает игра, как и все последующие творения чехов – чудесная атмосфера, которая здесь создаётся за счёт наимилейшей анимации, прекрасного визуального стиля и замечательной музыки вкупе с забавнейшими звуками. Игра до последнего будет держать вас с улыбкой на лице и в состоянии умиления. Наблюдать за забавно прыгающим гномиком и закликивать всякие предметы от цветочков до таракашек можно бесконечно.  Но если говорить в целом и отбросить всю написанную выше воду, то абсолютно все игры студии (и Саморост в том числе) описываются одной фразой – маленькое, но очень душевное приключение. Даже если очень сильно тупить, финальные титры вы увидите не позже чем через полтора часа. Но эти час-полтора оставят после себя хорошее настроение на весь оставшийся день. Маст хэвушка, благо цена располагает :3

[i]Знаете, чем хороши игры? Чем они отличаются от других видов искусства? Погружение. В кино мы просто наблюдаем за событиями со стороны, в книге...ну там погружение есть, но не настолько сильное как в играх. В играх мы примеряем на себя какую-то роль – рыцарь, солдат, обычный человек, спаситель галактики, вор и т.д. В играх нас погружают в какой-то особый мир, не похожий (ну иногда похожий) на наш. Рассказывают историю, в которой главный герой – ты. Да, ты, обычный пользователь стима, читающий этот обзор. Именно поэтому игры и прекрасны.   К чему я всё это говорю? К тому, что Ori and the Blind Forest – это яркий пример того, как простая как два пальца история способна выбить из человека слезу. Всего лишь за 10 минут, путём пары маленьких зарисовок Moon Studios удаётся создать эмоциональную связь между игроком и героем. История о слепом лесе очень проста, весьма банальна, шаблонна...и в тоже время очень атмосферна и трогательна. Рассказывать о сюжете я не буду – он заключается всего лишь в нескольких роликах, и, пожалуй, малейшая мелочь будет спойлером. Также промолчу и о графике – достаточно посмотреть на скриншоты. И это [b]Unity[/b]! Скажу честно, я ждала красивого, созерцательного приключения, но никак не эталонного геймплея...  По сути, это то, что нам обещали разработчики – платформер в лучших традициях Метроидваний и Рейманов. Нас бросают на большую карту, состоящую из нескольких локаций. В какие-то мы можем попасть сразу, в какие-то только с определёнными умениями. Есть локации, которые нам предстоит пройти по сюжету, и в которые затем нам нельзя будет вернуться. А есть мини-уровни, каждый из которых является самым настоящим испытанием на скорость и реакцию, и каждый из которых обязательно заканчивается красивым и эпичным побегом. Приличная часть игрового процесса приходится на изучение местности – по всему лесу разбросано множество секретов. Также иногда придётся не раз пробегать через знакомые места. Многие жалуются на это и говорят, что не помешало бы быстрое перемещение между окрестностями, но, как по мне, прогулки по старым тропинкам являются хорошей разрядкой после одного тяжёлого момента в преддверии другого, возможно ещё более тяжёлого.  Кстати, о сложности. Она идеально выдержана. Непросто, но и в меру сложно. Почти в каждой смерти виноват игрок. Не рассчитал траекторию отпрыгивая от заряда, сохранился в неудачный момент, просто не допрыгнул...За всё винить приходится себя. Но в то же время игра не вызывает бомбёжки и психов. Отдельная похвала – сохранения как боевой ресурс. Вы можете сохраняться каждые две минуты, но с трудом одолевать врагов. Или экономить энергию, но откатываться далеко назад из-за малейшей ошибки. Сохраняться приходится вручную, автосохранения здесь встречаются оооочень редко. А ещё можно сделать себе дополнительный челлендж – ячейки жизни и энергии тут нужно добывать самому. Можно просто ничего не искать и страдать. Также можно умереть и залюбовавшись местными пейзажами. Серьёзно.  Сопровождает в этом путешествии нас Сейн – маленький помощник, напоминающий Игникулюса из [b]Child of Light[/b]. Он, собственно, и отвечает за битвы с противниками. Поначалу наш герой очень слаб, его убивают с одного-двух ударов. В течении игры он начинает приобретать новые навыки и становится сильнее и быстрее. Двойной прыжок, отскакивания от врагов и вражеских зарядов, перо-парашют - это только треть местного ассортимента. Что особо радует, так это тот факт, что с появлением новой способности разработчики не забывают и о предыдущих. На протяжении всей игры мы чередуем абсолютно все приобретённые умения. В общем, геймплей отличный.[/i]  [i][b]Вердикт[/b]: красивая, увлекательная, атмосферная и душевная сказка, напоминающая лучшие мультипликационные творения Диснея. Трогательно, сказочно, в меру хардкорно. Рекомендуется.[/i]

If you grew up in the 16-bit era this is a must have. Let's face it, there are loads and loads of games on Steam right now trying to pull on the nostalgia chords. Loads of pay for roms and emu packages of games you know and love, and tons of indie games developed in the likeness of games you know and love, but what those games can't deliver is what Dorke has in mass quantity; an authentically new SNES experience. This isn't a game like a SNES game. This isn't a SNES game you've beaten countless times. This is an authentic SNES title you never got to play. If it was unplayable it'd still be a wortha few bucks to check out, but given it's actually a decent game it's a gem of an experience. I'd say the closest thing to Dorke and Ymp is when you find a game that never came to your nation online and in your language or at least a fan patch.  So what's the game actually like? It's decent, but nae great. If it did come out during the SNES days it definately wouldn't have excited me as much as it does now. It's slow, and hard, and some things are kind of lost in translation or just all out weird, but it's not horrible. The pair of characters over one PC is pretty neat. It may not be the only game to do something similar, but it is an interesting take and easy to do. You never have to think about which one you're going to use, just what you need to do and the pair takes care of the rest. My favorite thing about the game is the in game animations. There are quite a few animations that remind you not to take the game too seriously despite is being seriously difficult. The cutsenes are long, but I enjoyed them. I'd rather have them than not, though skipping would be nice sometimes.   I'm not sure what Piko did to finish the game. It's clearly another rom+emu package. It's a bit of a hard game and I wasn't so taken with it that I wanted to prove I could beat it without cheats so I took the rom and uploaded it to my Recalbox build to play Dorke and Ymp with fast foward, rewind, shaders, save and load states, etc. I'm not sure why pay-for emulators have less than free ones, but they do and that's the case here. I definately advocate buying the rom to support Piko for bringing it to us, but once you have it play it on your favorite emulator because the one it comes with is bogus.

Proxy Blade Zero is an easy and fun game. It requires patients, not mindless button mashing- doing so will get you scooped by the most basic enemies. Instead you have to dodge, weave, and note your enemies- find their patterns and exploit them. A classic formula that's tough to mess up and delivers satisfying game play.  However, this exploratory mindset is offset by an archaic life system that instills false difficulty in the game. Most enemies and bosses can trash you in a few clean hits while you investigate what they're all about. Yet the game punishes you for doing so- after three strikes you have to start the stage all over again. Its just a hassle to do the same thing over and over just so you can get back to a certain spot to find out a new enemy or bosses move set. I've played, beaten, and mastered too many games with lives- its dull. Give me one life or infinite lives to beat a game. I'm playing on a computer, not an arcade machine.  However if you have the time to kill Proxy Blade Zero can scratch that itch for a game with a deep combat system. Otherwise, move on. In short, Proxy Blade Zero is a game with a nice idea but marred with a single poor choice on the developer's side. It's a sale or coupon kind of game with life span of 1 to 2 hours.

*disclaimer; early access review; may change in the future*  *TL:DR at the bottom*  Sometimes you don't have a lot of money to spend on some AAA title. Sometimes, you don't want to support greedy corporate publishers like Electronic Arts, Ubisoft, and the like. Sometimes you just want a game to play while listening to a podcast or something. Royal Merchants, the fourth installment in Badim's Royal series is similar in tone to the the other two I have played (Royal Heroes and Royal Offense; haven't played the third yet myself) in that you hire heroes to go on quests to build up a strong kingdom. The difference, however, lies in the means of achieving this goal.  Whereas Heroes focused on a field battle with heroes leading squadrons of troops against hordes of goblins, orcs, and undead monsters, and Offense focused on sending troops from a castle funded by tax collectors to push against enemy castles, Merchants focuses on sending small parties of up to three heroes to hunt baddies and gather resources. These resources are used to craft equipment, not unlike Heroes, but instead of using a Minecraft-style crafting grid you hire craftsmen to make the items for you. An important distinction here is specifically about the items you craft, because not only do you equip your units with these items, but you can sell the items you don't want for coin - in fact, it is currently the main way you raise funds to hire new soldiers aside from converting the blue orbs you can collect from sheep you slaughter on an altar a la old-fashioned sacrificial offering. Overall, the mechanics are quite similar to other games that involve crafting and selling items, like Swag and Sorcery and Weapon Shop Fantasy, for those that recognize those titles.  In regards to aesthetics, you'll see a lot of familiar faces, mostly because the developers tend to reuse assets from earlier games in the series. To some people, this may make the game feel bland (especially because the game currently has no sound effects), but some people familiar with the franchise may even find it nostalgic, especially those with a preference for naming their characters. As far as the lack of sound is concerned, it may be jarring to some, but for people who play with the sound off so they can overlap a podcast, audiobook, or even their own soundtrack, this isn't much of a bother aside from the lack of audio cues for when a hero levels up, a task is complete, or a party fails to complete their quest to slay a relatively difficult opponent.  Naturally, this being an Early Access title, it should be noted that the game is in the process of being developed, and the developers have been very responsive to feedback from what I've seen. They clearly seem focused on making the game as enjoyable as possible, and try their best to listen to their community. They do not have a history of microtransactions as far as I'm aware of, having played three of their games, and I don't expect them to pull a fast one on us anytime soon in that regard, so I'd consider it 'safe' as far as the wallet is concerned.  TL;DR: It's a good low-budget casual game that I consider well worth the cheap price. People who play it casually can expect probably a few dozen hours worth of entertainment. Pairs well with audiobooks and podcasts, but doesn't have audio for people who'd rather focus solely on the game. Devs are friendly and responsive. I highly recommend to casual gamers and people who want something fun to play while catching up on the news or podcasts.

Starting out with your main protagonist Hajime the student council president.  For the most part he has minded his own business and kept the school in check.  Until one day he decides he wants to live life to the fullest.  So he proposes to lift a ban on romance.  This ban has been going on with the school for some time. Before you even choose your date you will be allowed to interact with a few different features allowing you to peak into our heroines current future and see what they are up to.  This will give you the options to get closer to the different main characters of the game and make a path for yourself to the true end game.  Throughout the story you will have comedy and romance filled throughout this story.  Making you want to know what happens next, where does Hajime end up?  Not only that watch as every single character is built up with strong character development.  Once all is said and done, you can share romantic moments with the woman of your choosing and live life to the fullest with someone by your side. Excellent game. Highly recommend.  科学怪人乡下小屋离奇死亡， 西方记者现场调查几陷险境，[spoiler] +1s [/spoiler] 破碎的月光机器， 神秘的能剧面具， 堪萨斯小镇郊外的晚上静悄悄...  以下评论仅基于VR版的体验  一周目3个多小时的游戏时间，完成了SCD三个结局 价格作为桌面游戏而言不能算实惠，[spoiler] 连胖次都没得看[/spoiler] 作为VR游戏来说，流程和体验远超过我接触过的免费demo类游戏  买之前没有看过任何相关的测评和视频，临时起意才买了玩的（小伙伴来家里聚会） 本来以为只是悬疑解谜类游戏，在游戏过程中才【突然】发现其实是具有恐怖元素的 我们五个人轮流戴VR，剩下的人在屏幕前观看流程 全程大概发生过5次以上的惊叫...【就冲这一点就值了】  游戏画面算不上精美，但是在VR模式下没有明显的颗粒感 画面比较流畅，音乐带来的紧张感也恰到好处 个人认为惊悚的部分还是VR版本才能够真的体验到，浸入感其实是很强烈的 解谜属于非常传统的调查场景、获得道具、解开小谜题，并没有什么和VR有关的操作 游戏的VR设置是原地式的，移动是靠按键实现而非真实移动 提示：如果你在现实中移动的话，游戏主人公的头部就会随你移动而身体则不会，然后你就可以身首异处地观察自己了  由于没有汉化，而调查中会得到大量文档，所以请做好大量阅读的准备 并不需要仔细阅读所有的内容，但是很多小解谜和最终判定凶手还是需要用到文档里的信息的 【托福阅读恐惧症慎入】 游戏中有几条不同的故事线，通过剧情推进相互交错 故事整体是现实的符合逻辑的，但同样有不少超现实的情节【你对这部分的理解会影响到结局判定】 让我想到的类似作品是Cube Escape: Rusty Lake系列，不过Rusty Lake里面psycho的成分可能更多一点吧  尽管有些不足，但是这个游戏在某些小细节的设置上真是“得人心” 不仅是通过环境设置带给VR玩家视听上的压迫感，更有心情落差带给人的心理上的压力 【游戏中同样设置了sensitive模式，胆小的玩家可以使用】 强烈建议在有人陪同的情况下进行VR体验，万一你被吓到了呢[spoiler] 还能有个人看到你出丑的样子[/spoiler]  最后的忠告:当然是选择原谅ta啊!

******POSSIBLE SPOILER, NOTHING REALLY REVEALING AT ALL THOUGH******      This game is kind of different than 3 and NV. It is hard to say how, but if you put hours into those games you will see what I mean. It is like NV in the sense that the player has great affect on the world around him/her. In NV, the Courier gets involved in a political war between factions trying to gain control of New vegas as well as the Mojave wastes. In Fallout 3, The Long Wanderer is essentially forced into joining the Brotherhood in a quest to find and inevitably help his father. Fallout 4 is pretty in between when it came to this, and it is what I was looking for. NV's questline was very roleplay-y which a lot of people loved. I didn't mind it, but having an affect on the whole world didn't mean as much to me as the feeling that Fallout 3 gave me. When you play that game alone, you feel lonely. You feel for the Lone Wanderer as he was left by his father out of the blue and his sheltered life is quickly manifested by the corruption and ugly truth of the Capital wastes. Fallout 4 finds a way in the middle of the two ideas, which I suppose can cater to all people.   The building is a meaningful addition to the game, but it certainly does have flaws. Things don't really snap into place and it takes a lot of time and frustation to make a good looking build. The build cap does get annoying too. In addition, people don't feel like they are really involved in the world. I'd say I have 35-45 hours in the game and I somewhat agree. There is a lot of world to explore, but from what I have seen no Megatons or ghoul invasions on Tenpenny Tower. I still have a lot to see, so take that lightly.   Combat I think is fantastic, and weapon ugrading is cool as well. Each enemy has its own strengths and weaknesses (besides Mirelurk Killclaws, don't think they have a weakness besides their 1 pixel heads). Deathclaws are very scary, and are sold as these titans that are impossible to kill and are definitely worthy of that hype.  All in all, I think it is a great game. I am a Fallout fanatic and this game was all I've been waiting for. I don't think for me it tops Fallout 3 as of yet. People think New Vegas is the best of all, and I see why, but for me I loved 3. The best thing is the modding tools for this game will be great. I know some people have the sentiment that the game should not need outside sources to fix the game and make it better, but I am not a professional critic and don't care so long as I get the most fun out of the game. I think we should all have the feeling. because we are all going to get the mods and have a blast regardless.  I give the game a 8.5/10, probably higher than most will give but I really do like this game a lot.

Holy Fuck! This is a good game! I picked this game up on sale and got all the episodes for around $10(So, wait if you can for a sale!) and my god I have to say that the money was well spent. The art style while very basic looks great even when the character models look awful. The story has been very well written and revised. The choices you make do come back to haunt you in one way or another. One major mistake I made in this game is that I didn't take the scenic route so I missed A LOT, so be sure to look around for everything and think of past events. This game was like a lifetime with friends, you laugh, you cry, you get mad, ect. and I can say I got attached to characters so much that I would talk to my computer screen. This game made me ponder a lot of my personal opinions like the use of doctor assisted suicide and suicide in general.  Now, I do have some bad things to say about this game. It glitches rarely, but when it does it's really annoying as typically it freezes everything around you and doesn't let you countinue. The lip-syncing is just awful at times, there were times that 1. My audio would just straight up stop or 2. Characters wouldn't even be moving their lips. There is no manuel save and while it does auto-save a lot it's annoying when you have to stop in the middle of an investigation and close your game and start over. Random FPS, now this is not a hard game to run and I have a good PC, but it would sometimes just slow down in the middle of a cutscene or while I was walking. The time rewind power is awesome, but it is flawed so much mathematically and game-wise. If you want to go back to change a major decision you have to go back to the first branch of a convo tree and run through it again to get to the one choice you want. Also, you can't rewind to wherever in the game which I would like to do due to he fact that I realized how awful my decisions were. I understand no game can be perfect, but god damn I wish there was more thought put into time rewind. In conclusion, this game in my opinion is great and even if you're not sure just pick up the demo. The ending will make you seriously consider everything you did in the game. 希望能早日开放创意工坊，人物美化mod、人物属性编辑mod我认为是其中非常重要的。虽然以一个欧美人的角度看的确是已经尽量还原历史了，可是其中仍然有一系列与历史及其违和的地方存在，尤其是在武将的细节上（娄圭居然是个披甲戴盔的将军...）。当然，全战系列从来都对每一个历史人物精雕细琢毫无兴趣，毕竟它是一个大战略、大纵横的策略游戏。而且这种习惯我认为也跟西方的史学发展习惯与东方的不一样有关。不同于西方自古以来就有私家修史的传统，中国史书更范式化，二十四部纪传体通史就是最好的代表。同时又由于西方在中世纪前五百年所遭受到的文化上的打击，把本身就所存不多的古典文献和辛辛苦苦积累起来的发展经验丢了大半，这也就造成了西方史学并不可能向中国史学一样能够把很多历史细节保存的很好，自然而然的，许多的历史人物以及发生在他们身上的故事也就不会像中国古典历史那样被人们所熟知了。除了靠中世纪中期阿拉伯国家的“大翻译运动”、拜占庭帝国史学家的记载和保存（比如Suda）以及教会对各个地区Archivio的保护，西方古典史学的现代化发展离不开纸草学与考古学，而也正是凭借着这些才将古典历史的大部分样貌还原了个七七八八。因此，在今天西方业余历史爱好者的眼中，他们只能看到曾经对历史做出极大影响的人物的身影，却不会去理会品达诗里的那些配角和他们的生活；而中国的历史爱好者则更愿意从一本本纪传体通史中出现的色彩鲜明的各色人物中去发觉快乐，而这也就造就了以西方古典史学传统为基调的sega的三国全战在历史人物的塑造上注定不可能做出类似于光荣公司三国志系列的那种考究。当然这也并不意味着三国全战就不考究，它的考究是在另一个层面上的。比如政治联姻和继承模式、反腐败系统与间谍系统，这其中有向p社学的也有借鉴前作Attila的，虽然不能说是完美（其中尤其是创作者对“部曲”的理解有很大的问题，他们更倾向于把“部曲”等同于从罗马共和国中晚期就出现的“私兵”的含义；另一个问题就是创作者没能很好的把“门阀士族”的概念融合进游戏，不然效果肯定会锦上添花），但相对于一个英国人做出的中国古代史早期的游戏已经是够够的了。     以上是我今天体验一整天游戏的感想。可能大家会觉得我有些过于苛刻了，其实我只是希望这个游戏或者说全战这个系列能够做的更好而已，就整个游戏体验来说要我给分的话，我保底会给8.5分，已经属于精品中的精品了，只希望未来的DLC能够不让我失望。

I can’t remember the last time I felt this much love for what is essentially a broken game. And when I say “broken” I mean “good luck completing it or even getting it running without a patch” level broken.  I have never seen a western RPG that managed to build such a rich world, full of fleshed out characters that felt alive and unique on each play through, where just changing your clan to Malkavian, or the “Hard mode” Nosferatu could give you a radically different experience. It oozes atmosphere and style, from the music to the surprisingly lovingly animated character models. (Remember, this is a 2004 game).  Most of the time you feel like you are a vampire detective in a seedy crime riddled city, more of a Sam Spade than a Dracula. You piece together mysteries, take on Drug Dealers and supernatural threats, and track down bail jumpers and murderers. Heck you even perform an exorcism. (or not, depending on how you do the quest.) You can trick your character out, both skill and dialog choice wise, any way you see fit.   Even though the game suffered from declining quality as it progresses, you still want to see what happens. I think part of the appeal to the dialogs and characters is that it’s not always PC, tackles adult topics like addiction and jealousy, is not always conform to the norm, and judgement of what you do isn’t passed by the game but by you as a character. Is sending a victim who narrowly escaped death back to a cannibalistic monster something you feel comfortable with? Do you want to send a loudmouthed ghoul on a wild goose chase, or to an agonizing demise? Even the ending in itself is “different” to say the least.   Another amazing feat is that the game conveys all necessary world info and lore to you without any obvious exposition, and conversations never feel drawn out. Top quality voice acting (again, not a given in 2004) rounds it off. On the mutual side, the game in vanilla mode is full of game breaking bugs, especially towards the end. So make sure to download the unofficial patch, which fixes not just game breakers, but also enhances graphics and restores content. There is also no Controller support, so software that logs gamepad keys to keyboard inputs will be necessary if “wasd” sounds like bad alphabet soup to you.  On the negative side of the spectrum, there are some parts of the game that have racist stereotypes. Chinatown’s denizens are especially cringe worthy, and some black characters are beyond cartoonish.   And the biggest problem: combat. Especially early in the game, it feels like your wildly flailing your arms around while praying you hit and kill the enemy before they gang up on you and send you out on the breeze. While you can spend the first half of the game avoiding combat by sneaking around, the endgame will have you going full John Wick. Which is a problem if you neglected your combat skills. If you balanced your character you should be okay, but to me, a stealthy killer through and through, it feels like a chore. Chinatown and the endgame lack side quests, npc’s and overall just make it apparent that the game was pushed for release before it was complete.  In the end, the amazing experience outshines the bad combat and “old Game problems” by far, so patch it up, come for the great story and characters, and hope against hope that the sequel can recapture the magic of the glorious mess that is Bloodlines.

Compressed version of my review of Brut@l for TechSocket.net:  Brut@l pays homage to the days when heroes and villains in video games were defined by little more than text symbols navigating dungeons constructed of dashes and dots. Brut@l’s shining moments in gameplay come from this stunning stylization. But it doesn’t just sit high on its own assurance of nostalgia for graphics of the past to carry the design. It runs with the roots of dungeon crawlers while incorporating modern capabilities to craft a stylized world overflowing with designers running wild with the opportunity to craft three dimensional worlds out of the computer symbols for which we’ve become so familiar.   During your journey in Brut@l, all the landscapes, foes and items are conjured nearly entirely out of a combination of blank black space and white ASCII computer symbols. Yet the symbols don’t just pertain to the environment you navigate through. They’re also used in creative ways with the game’s core mechanics. The majority of the world you will encounter lies in the aforementioned monochrome palette. It builds up a very unique atmosphere. Brut@l’s musical score helps to bring you deeper into the dungeon. It’s not quite as memorable as some other OSTs, but it adds to the atmosphere with a dark, drum-pounding soundtrack laden with tension.  Brut@l’s combat system is a somewhat simplified mix of games like Diablo and Gauntlet. You’ve got four slots that can be equipped to the diversity of crafted weapons, potions and items. The game has four characters from which to choose at the start of a dungeon run: Mage, Ranger, Amazon, and Warrior. Each of the characters have slightly different spreads across their basic attributes, like health and what skills or tools they have to start with. Each class begins with a slightly different array of unlocked skills, or magical abilities. But, after a few floors of the dungeon – once you’ve upgraded a few skills, gained some armor and crafted a weapon – the differences in the classes start to melt away.  Brut@l’s combat system might not have the strategy or depth of some games, but it still remains savagely enjoyable. Brut@l is the “comfort food” of video games. The sensation of plowing through waves of enemies, rapidly upgrading your characters and their equipment is just plain fun. It’s not too challenging or frustrating, just goblin pummeling pleasure that tickles the visceral side of your brain. After about 3 weeks I've been using this along with a wired logitech pro device that I've had since...oh the ps2 days. I got it because I didn't want to mice and keyboard my way through Hitman. Anyway, to best describe the controller is that it's not weird, but different. Yes, this controller is different and for some that could either be a good thing, or a bad thing.   I have small hands, but generally a lot of people still say the controller is big. Yes, that is true, but I thought it was comfortable. It's thick and it does have some weight on it. The biggest complaint is finding the buttons. When I first purchased it, the store guy said that he confuses the X and A buttons with the Y and B buttons. It does happen, but that has to do with 2 reasons: 1.The size of the controller and 2. just getting used to the control scheme. It's funny, because that was the biggest complaint from the store guy the control scheme. Not the weight, or what I think is the biggest issue (I'll get to that in a moment). The more I used it, I got more comfortable with the buttons. I actually like the toggles underneath because I don't feel that they are gimmicky and in fact,  I actually see those being used in console devices. What does feel weird is the right touchpad. Taking the place of a traditional right stick, the right pad is clickable on the edges and you can add haptic feedback so it gives you a sense a touch when touching the edges. The left pad is similar so if you want to touch the controls as opposed to pressing them you can.   But, my huge issue with this pad is the fact that it's a controller with a very high learning curve. Good luck finding ways to program this thing. It's been over 6 months since it's release and I still can't find a way to properly program this thing. It's flexible, and that is a good thing, but no instructions mean that programming it to find a sweet spot is hit or miss. The community does offer settings you can download and use to serve as default controls, for most games, but it's hit or miss. And that's a shame because unless a developer submits a default control scheme you're not sure what to really expect. Sometimes the community gives you something that gives you a better, while other times you have to jump back and forth in your game trying to get comfortable finding just the feel. Most of the issues stem from the amount of feedback you want from the mouse pad regions of both the left and right pads. For some it's a matter of getting used to it, for others that need buttons or a stick, you're not going to enjoy the experience as much.   Now saying all that...I love this controller! I have yet to test this out on fighting games, but for adventure, platform, third person and fps games, this controller is great. The ability to program keyboard inputs into your controller without the use of mods or patches is a godsend. The weight of the device doesn't hamper me at all. The ability to adjust the speed of the right pad gives me the ability to line up shots easier if I want to go slow, or if I want to make it faster I can (I realize I just complained about the right pad, but the issue was the learning curve). The bumpers underneath are not gimmicky as much as they are useful. Perhaps the most exciting thing I like about it is that I'm no longer stuck using keyboard and mouse controls. I can now purchase older games that were built for kb+m controls and map them directly to a controller. It's not perfect because I can't find a control scheme that I like, but I no longer have to find alternatives.   Overall, I would recommend this controller for those that don't want to use a kb+m and don't have or want an xbox 360 or One controller. If you got one of those keep them and use them. Most games read those inputs anyway. But, if you don't want one of those controllers, and don't mind tinkering with the controls for the first 30 minutes of your game, than I think you would like this controller.

Okay so what can I say that hasnt already been said. Bethesda has made another winner with only a few caviots. So this starts out like a strong emmersive world with infinite possibilities. Vunderbar! And beyond this we also get new mechanics from a very old idea within the mythos, settlement building! wonderful to see homage paid to those original Fallout games. However, because this game starts out so glitchy we find ourselves in wonder of the developers attention to detail. Now dont get me wrong, this game is very detailed. Every quadrant is filled with loads of loot, exceptional re-hashes of classic wasteland wanderers, and infinite supply of useful items. At first glance, Bethesda has solved everything. To expand on Fallout 3's insistance on placing hundreds of thousands of unusable items and Fallout New Vegas's bulky and virtually pointless ammo crafitng systems, Fallout 4 has yet again answered all queries and complaints. Now it seems like I have only good things to say here, but unfortunately I have found the game...Lackluster. Take it from me when I tell you I am not without hope. I have played Bethesda games for a total of over 4000, thats right 4000 hours. I know what they do right because I am partial to their style. Having played FO4 for only 250 hours I can already see a problem. I am a completionist and many of you who play this developers games are similar. This is why we love these games. We want to know everything, but we also want to be challenged. I am now level 65 and there is no challenge in the game that I can find. I have roamed the wastes of the Commonwealth and Glowing Sea and there is no competition for me. What am I to do other than feel like a total champion. The only problem is, with no level cap excluding the 200+ perk increases, I will be unopposed for the remaining 140 some odd levels remaining. Now mods are dandy but they cannot come under review of a developers initial intent. So at this point I have resigned myself to a hiatus of gameplay until my hopes come true and Bethesda releases that sweet sweet DLC. In terms of story and graphics and all the other mumbo jumbo which many people worked tireless hours for, I thank you. I have some issues with some of it but that is for another time. And no, I could not do it better if I tried but that doesnt prevent me from being picky. Sadly Bethesda could release interactive poop in a box and I would still be in love with it. What can I say, Im a sucker for adventure and Fallout 4 does not dissapoint on that front!  If youve made it this far, thank you for reading this meager reviewer's opinion of yet another wonderful piece of video game art.  Forever yours Bethesda, Cobra Doogan

It's a somewhat less interactive, more punishing, gothic rendition of Minecraft. I enjoy the game enormously, though the crafting system and some of the mechanics are mind-bending, in that they are not rational. In the example of the latter, it is evident that despite reason, certain mechanics exist to complicate or make more difficult the act of surviving/gameplay in general. To be fair, Klei comes right out and states the title is meant to be punishing, however I find the lack of logic applied to certain mechanics somewhat fourth wall-breaking. Nevertheless, DST is charming and a lot of fun. It is further improved by any number of mods and it is clear that the developer is hell-bent on keeping it relevant/including new content regularly. Well worth the investment.

这是一款节奏非常非常慢的游戏，但可玩性却非常非常高。 简单的与类似游戏RUST官服对比一下，有如下几种： 一：同样作为慢节奏游戏，这款游戏具备更加庞大的细节，包括游戏设计里面所包含的各种关联要素，需要玩家去仔细研磨才能明白。 二：在操作性上，新版RUST更加流畅，而这款游戏需要玩家去区分各种需要，所以几乎0流畅。 三：RUST可以作为单人游戏玩，多人配合会更加高效。而这款游戏没有多人配合甚至人数太少都会十分难驾驭。 四：画质上RUST经过前代更新后，已经自成一体。而这款游戏优化还在我的期待中。 五：RUST更偏向于竞争。这款游戏更偏向于休闲合作。 总之，如果有大量时间并且喜欢生生存、喜欢攻克和研究各种游戏细节、喜欢体验游戏性的玩家不妨入手这款游戏。当你发现你想建造一间最小的房子时需要包括收集材料制作简易工具，挖土，填土，平整土地，挖石头，搬运，铺路，建造地址，伐木，分割原木及木块木板，采集茅草，添加，最后成型，你才会发现原来玩游戏的乐趣在于拥有一大批志同道合的朋友，大家一起聊聊天吹吹牛皮是多么难得，但你以为这游戏只是单单大家一起挖土砍树盖楼这么简单吗？不，你错了，在这里面职业划分是非常模糊的，你可以专职一种职业，也可以多修，假如你拥有一些十分靠谱的朋友，愿意帮你盖房子，你就能成为一个更加强大的战士，或者医生，或者厨师，或者农民，或者狩猎师，或者伐木工，或者矿工，或者酿酒师甚至炼金术师等等。所以建议大家可以入手这款游戏，如果处于打折时期则更加划算。

In termini di single player Tekken 7 offre un'enorme mole di contenuti e possibilità: è possibile personalizzare i costumi dei personaggi in ogni singola parte (colore compreso), giocare ad una modalità storia (il tipico Arcade) corta ma impegnativa e oltre a quella anche delle mini storie con solo scontro, allenarsi posizionando a schermo i comandi di ogni mossa senza dover passare dal menu, simulare sempre in allenamento l'effetto lag (rallentamenti dovuti alla rete), combattere all'infinito una modalità che consente di sbloccare ulteriori elementi di personalizzazione del personaggio. In tutto questo popò di roba mancano però una modalità sfida (di quelle che ti presenta una serie di combo da eseguire prima di poter passare alla successiva) , una funzionalità di registrazione delle partite e l'instant replay.  Per il resto, è Tekken: 3d combat, niente autocombo, torna il rage che si attiva raggiunto un certo valore di vita residua, prese, immane quantità di mosse e possibilità di combo e un sistema di controllo non troppo pignolo per chi allo stick preferisce il controller. Di nuovo c'è il Rage Drive, ossia una mossa potente che consuma rage utile per estendere combo e che non innesca il mini filmatino della normale Rage Art.

Wolfenstein II wasn't quite as good as its predecessor, but overall I'd say it was decent. Graphically, the game looks so much better than the first one. The story isn't too bad, although sometimes the story beats felt like they had conflicting tones and messages. There was definitely some more humor and comedic moments in this game compared to the first one. My biggest complaint is the gunplay and level design. The gunplay felt off, and there was never a huge reason to switch weapons, they all performed the same. Level design wise, the game was pretty dull, and incredibly linear. If it's on sale, pick it up, if not, I wouldn't bother.

Nostalgia does hold up for the Infernal Machine, something not often said for many titles *cough* the Italian Job *cough*. While the graphics may look dated the gameplay is simple but satisfying. I was able to adjust the controls to a more modern layout, and I could've even hooked up a controller. I did not experience any compatibility issues and the game ran fine. The resolution is not patched for 1080p and above however, but in all honesty the game looks no different no matter what resolution you run it on since it's so old. This game is so damn good at making and maintaining tension. The music and the attachments you will form with your characters make the fights intense. Every choice feels as if it impacts your current situation, and every hit or miss turns the tides of battle. That being said, with that tension comes a weariness to actually play the game. I love the feeling associated with this game, but I ultimately want to play calmer games with a lot less on the line, so I end up coming to this game occasionally just to get a good rush.   So, I guess a few things that stuck with me would be: The soundtrack, which propels the tension in fights and makes the game much better. The narrator, whose lines push the theme of the game pretty hard and are thoroughly enjoyable to listen even to, when you've heard them many times. The classes and style of combat, based on positioning and making hard choices. How well sanity mixes with the rest of the game, and can add new tension to fights, with enemies based on lowering the sanity of your characters to screw up your team. And certainly the artstyle, which is absolutely gorgeous and immediately gives off what the enemies and classes do, with some twists to keep it interesting.  To be frank, I can't think of anything I dislike about this game. It's all really fun in my opinion. You'll get pissed off with losing, but that's natural, and it helps you learn from your mistakes.  I would absolutely recommend you buy this. Also, the modding community is good.

Iron Snout, rápido, frenético, acción por todas partes, lobos asesinos y un cerdo karateca.  Es un beat ´em up (yo contra el barrio) bastante simple en el cual controlas a un cerdo con habilidades karatecas que intenta sobrevivir a oleadas de lobos asesinos armados. El propio juego busca tu muerte complicando en muchas ocasiones el enfrentamiento y creando así partidas rápidas y frenéticas que pondrán a prueba tu habilidad creando combos.  Gráficamente es muy simple pero colorido y con toques gore que le suman diversión al mismo. Sus mecánicas, se basan en movimientos laterales con las flechas o bien con W/A/S/D, aun así son muy atractivas y funcionan bastante bien. El sonido no es gran cosa pero acompaña muy bien a la acción.  El juego por si solo ya es adictivo pero para alargar la experiencia, contiene un total de 28 logros muy interesantes y fáciles de alcanzar, pero te llevará un tiempo. Tiene varios modos de juego: el modo clásico en el que empiezas con un 100% de vida e intentas sobrevivir a las oleadas; el modo 1HP en el que con solo 1% debes sobrevivir e intentar que no te den ni un solo golpe; y un tercer modo que actualmente está en Beta que consiste en jugar un 1 vs 1 con un amigo en el mismo ordenador.  Iron Snout no es un juego que busque emocionarte con su narrativa puesto que no tiene ninguna aparte de pensar que puede estar basado en el cuento de “Los tres cerditos y el lobo feroz”. Nous voici sur Endorlight, un jeu rétro en 2D à mi-chemin entre le RPG et le platformer. Le but est d'arriver le plus loin possible dans les niveaux, vous avez une vie, une seule. Prenez des coeurs de vie, des pièces... Tout est réinitialisé à chaque niveau, sauf votre argent. Ce qui fait que votre vie est de retour à 5 coeurs, même si vous en aviez 6 ou 7, mais les niveaux aussi sont réinitialisés ! Pas 2 niveaux identiques ! Des ennemis aléatoires, des boss... Heu, les ennemis explosifs sont chiant car ils peuvent vous ruiner votre niveau en détruisant le terrain. Alors sauvegardez et rechargez votre save, le niveau sera reset. PS : j'espère que vous maîtrisez le Wall-Jump  Ma notation :  Graphismes  -dans le thème minecraft version 8bits 1/5 mais 4/5 pour un jeu rétro  Audio -dans le thème musique électronique, parfait pour un jeu rétro, légèrement stressant 2/5 mais 3/5 pour un jeu rétro  Gameplay -Il faut maîtriser le wall-jump (1-2h de jeu), les commandes clavier sont pourries ( optimisées pour manette ) et les hitbox sont buggées ( dur de toucher un pot ) 1/5  Diversité -le point fort du jeu ! totalement aléatoire, pas 2 même levels, tellement que certains sont impossibles, rechargez votre save, le niveau sera reset ! Du jamais vu sur les jeux rétro, et un pari réussi ! 4/5 et 5/5 pour un jeu rétro  Conclusion : 2/5 si vous n'aimez pas les jeux rétro ( musique, graphismes, gameplay ) mais 4/5 si au contraîre vous cherchez un bon petit jeu rétro pour se détendre. 试玩玩了一下，有些失望，如果一定要给个分数的话7.5/10。 本着等待改进与提升的心态给一个差评。  ----------------------------------------- +优秀的画面，舒服的色调 +极为流畅自然的人物动作  +/-打击音效尚可 +/-融合了moba的玩法(强者更强 +/-易上手，以至于你完成了新手教程就玩过了大部分的玩法  -模式偏少，耐玩性不高(几个小时就有点腻了) -砍杀爽快感不足，处决动作屈指可数 -真正冷兵器的浪漫只存在于1v1，而这个模式并不火 -服务器至今日仍比起r6略差 ----------------------------------------- 看到很多人说平衡不好，目前体验还行，可能那是上几个版本的事情了，才玩了几小时对此不作评论。 对于一个冷兵器爱好者来说，更令人兴奋的莫过于自身对于兵器的技巧的提升。 但是在游戏中，尤其是多人游戏中，更多是靠阴人而不是堂堂正正的对决获胜。 本游戏也有着出招表的设计，每个角色都各不相同，相比传统的格斗游戏招数种类更少硬直更大。 同时因为锁定系统的关系，让你同时处理来自背后的敌人几乎不可能。（其实往往就是聚众围殴，小混混即视感（划掉 而当对手逃跑时，想要追上对方几乎是一件不可能的事情，而且追击者经常会被一群人围殴。这就让游戏演变成了将对手打退然后抓紧时间在小兵堆里开无双，并且还要担心防止被对面趁乱摸一刀。 真正比拼技巧的还是1v1，需要对各个人物出招有足够了解，也可以全心全意专注于拆招解招。然而碍于服务器，往往是延迟低的那方获胜。  剧情方面比较老套，这样和r6类似定位的竞技游戏和单机的剧情自然没法比，不过还是为单机过程添了不少乐趣。  竞技游戏嘛，在拟真方面就不做评价了武士刀砍重甲不卷刃，重甲满地图乱跑不吃力。  希望服务器和玩法上能有所进步吧。 这种3D格斗+moba的玩法的确是有新意，但是要买的话就算是5折我也觉得偏贵了（壕请无视）。

What Greedfall lacks in certain areas it makes up for in its story telling. As an open world RPG it does a good job of introducing players to a new, vibrant world. The main story starts slow but does soon pick up, becoming progressively more interesting and engaging. This was backed up with player decisions and actions shaping the reputation the player holds with companions and other factions. The side quests were each unique and interesting enough to keep me engaged without pulling me too far from the main story. The open world environment was interesting with each region being diverse enough to explore, with plenty of new paths to take and potentially open up. The combat differed enough to keep it challenging with each enemy type requiring a slightly different combat approach, however, over time this can become repetitive. The levelling system allows players to create and experiment with some unique and interesting play styles. The characters are well written with interesting motives and personalities, most of which felt unique. The main drawbacks for me were more the visual and technical issues. For instance, the copy and paste faces on certain npc's, coupled with the sometimes noticeable off timing mouth animations (especially early game, but becoming much less noticeable over time), and some what looked like unfinished camera angles during certain dialogue scenes, were a little immersion breaking, and it was these issues which became the draw back of the experience. In my play through I also noticed some serious lag in the built up cities as well as a couple of other areas, though during combat, dialogue, and when exploring the wilds, the game played smoothly.  My play through lasted 46 hours, however you could easily reach over 50 if you decide to hunt down all the collectables. I do recommend this game, even at full price if you're looking for an fresh, enjoyable narrative driven experience that will fill your time. 8.5/10.

The game is otherwise extremely fast paced and fun to run through, killing everything in your path. It also has ties to games like Bladerunner, with parkour being a huge movement apparatus for the game. I'm currently trying to 100% the game, and i'm still having fun going through the whole process of doing it, it isn't boring, but challenging and exciting.

The idea of Rust is very simple! You spawn naked with very limited tools/resurces: A ROCK and A TORCH... You can harvest material such as wood, stone and cloth, with help of these resources will you be able to make weapons,tools and clothes. You can kill animals for meat, but you can also hunt other players for their resources! Other players can also hunt you! There's no rules in rust, kill or be killed!   [b]Rust is a 24/7 Pvp game[/b], anyone can kill you when you're gathering resources, anyone can kill you when you're crafting, anyone can kill you when you're sleeping! You're simply NEVER completely safe. You can build a shelter to protect yourself. Anyone dedicated enough can gather the resources to kill you and take all your resources!  Rust is a game that constantly evolve(Update [b][u]EVERY[/u][/b] week). New items getting added, weapons getting balanced, Workshop skins getting added ingame, etc. The developers are listening to the community and is making progress together with the fans of the game!   Warning: [i]Trust issues might worsen[/i]

Portal(2007) é um jogo desenvolvido pela Valve, bem divertido que cumpre sua função muito bem, sem ficar datado e creio que vai se sustentar daqui a muitos anos. Porém, a narrativa é rasa demais e para esse tipo de jogo, acho que ficaria melhor sem uma pseudo-história.(Não estou falando da ambientação nem do plot básico que inclui você lutando contra o sistema) A vilã, Glados começa o jogo adicionando um humor cínico mas conclui ficando irritante demais e me fazendo querer tirar o som do jogo. O jogo é muito fácil e uma pessoal com inteligência normal zera em umas 5 horas. A campanha é curta e não há uma rejogabilidade alta.  Os principais momentos são o início e o final, onde eu me diverti mais, pois a boss battle contra a Glados é muito bem executada e o início também é muito interessante. Uma das coisas que eu mais gostei e fez eu adicionar um ponto  na nota que eu dou para o jogo é a ambientação, que é excelente; sublime! Um clima frio e quase aterrorizante de uma empresa do mal. O jogo tem um clima de terror psicológico que é muito bom e funciona muito bem, porque é muito imprevisível o que vai seguir, e a ideia também de se rebelar contra o dono do sistema que controla tudo é muito boa e inteligente. (ister kol ister bacak farketmez)  + Birinci maddeye bağlı olarak, herhangi bir bomba, tank mermisi, RPG sizi yerinizden zıplatabilir. Demek istediğim herkes tek bir class için yarışa girmiyor(Sniper oyuncuları hariç) her class iş yapıyor.  +Oyunda teamkill var, fakat kasıtlı yaptığınız sürece damage size geri dönüyor, sonra devam ederseniz oyundan atılıyorsunuz.  @@@ EKSİLER:   -Bu oyunda fazla eksik göremediğim için kendimce eksik bulduklarımı yazıcam.  -Oyuncu sayısı bir tık az. 14vs14 yerine 20vs20 olabilirdi.   -Etrafta çok fazla insan pusabiliyor, oyun zaten genel olarak AttackerxDefender oyunu olduğu için Push oyun modu için konuşuyorum(önce bir takım saldırıyor diğer takım defans yapıyor, sonra diğer takım saldırıyor) Defans yapanlar haliyle pusması gerekir. Ama CSGO ' daki gibi pusan oyuncular keklik gibi gözükmüyor. 5 6 kere art arda spawn lanıp öldüğümü bilirim. Bu yüzden pusan oyunculara karşı sinirlerin gerilmesi normal.  -Aslında bu sadece Insurgency e özel bir durum değil ama yine de belirteyim, objective almanız gerekirken takımınızda oturup adam çıkmasını bekleyenler olabilir, objective e hiç saldırmayanlar olabilir.  -Drone lar patlayıcıdır,(bunu özellikle belirtiyorum çünkü bir kere yedim o yar*ağı). Bomba hafif kalır yanında.  @@@ TAVSIYELER :  1-Sakın ama sakın Rush B taktiğini uygulamayın. Sakince gidin, sağa sola bakarak gidin, koşup adamı gördüğünüzde bir anda aim alıp öldüreceğinizi düşünmeyin. 2-Tek başına da zevk verir fakat arkadaşınız olursa veya squad ınız daha zevkli olur. 3-Attacker iken Gunner class ından uzak durabilirsiniz. Eğer Squad iseniz takımınızda 3 tane düzgün Rush atabilecek varsa alabilirsiniz. İstina durumlarda da alınabilir. 4-Lütfen attacker iken objective lere oynayın. 5-Lütfen defender iken bölgenize yakın olun(Sniper ve Gunner class istisna, onlar duruma göre uzak olabilir) 6-RPG yi veya grenade launcher kullanmıyacaksanız Demolitions class ını meşgul etmeyin. 7-Yakından rush atmak isterseniz, veya objective i yakından korumak isterseniz Breacher class ını alabilirsiniz.  8-Arkadaşınız varsa Commander, Observer ikilisini yapabilirsiniz.(Aşağıda açıklıyacağım)  @@@ Şimdi yeni başlayacak arkadaşlar için kısaca oyundaki Sınıfları tanıtayım.  Rifleman : Bu class özelliksiz gözüküp dışlansa da takımda büyük rol oynar. Herhangi kullanılabilir bir özelliği yoktur. Temel silahları kullanır M16, AK-47 gibi.  Commander : Bu sınıfta primary weapon olarak, Assault rifles and Battle rifles vardır. Artillery strike dan tut, chemical mortar'a ondan tut silahlı helikoptere kadar çeşitli destek araçlarını çağırmak için özel dürbünü vardır. Fakat kendi başına iş görmez. Yanında bir Observer yani radyo operatörü olması gerekir.  Observer : Primary rifle olarak Commander'ın tüfeklerini kullanır. Radyo operatörü olarak tanımlanabilir. Commander'ın taleplerini merkez üsse iletmekle sorumludur. Bu yüzden Commander'ın yanında gezmelidir.  Breacher : Pompalı tüfek, hafif makineli veya carbine tüfekleri kullanabilen classtır. CQB silahları ve patlayıcıları sayesinde odaları temizlemekten sorumludur. Yakın oynamak isteyen oyuncular için birebirdir.  Advisor : Bu class ın özel bir yeteneği yoktur. Özelleştirilmiş silahlar kullanır. SCAR(Mk 17 mod), L82A2, SKS, AKS-74U, Alpha AK gibi.  Gunner : Class ın adı zaten ne özelliği olduğunu açıkça tanımlıyor. Favori classımdır. Deployable machine guns kullanır. Defender class da çok büyük rol oynar. Genelde Defender olarak oynanan maçlarda scoreboard da en üstlerde yer alır. Saldırganların ilerlemelerini kritik bir şekilde durdurabilir. Fakat düzgün yere konuşlanmanız önemlidir. Defender olarak Gunner oynadığınız halde yeniliyorsanız. Gunner ı bilen bir kişiye teslim etmenizi öneririm. (Tabiki kazanmak için değil zevk için oynuyorsanız o başka.)  Demolitions : Bu class favori classlarımdan biridir, hedefleri yok etmek, uçakları düşürmek, düşmanları pusuya düşürmek veya evin içinde camplayanlara iyi geceler demek için patlayıcılar kullanır(RPG gibi). Her iki takımda da tercih edilebilir. Yapacağı hamleler kritiktir. Özellikle defender lar tarafından ilk roundda çok iş görür. Saldıranlar makinali tüfekli arabayla geleceği için direkt onları patlatırlar. Namlunuzun altına grenadelauncher da takabilirsiniz. Şahsen ben öyle kullanıyorum RPG yanında.   Marksman : Geldik oyunun gözde, herkesin gözdesi olan sniper classına. Bu class hakkında fazla açıklama yapmaya gerek yok, uzun mesafeli dürbünlü silahlar kullanırlar (M24, MK14, Mosin, SVD, M99). Defender classta ilk dolan classtır kendisi.

This is a surprisingly well polished Early Access title.   The concept is a unique one, there isn't any other game out there quite like it. And that is what the community has been missing. Personally it reminds me of Life Is Feudal: MMO because it's easy to get outnumbered and eaten like a sheep that's wandered too far off the herd. Combat wise it is very similar (but way smoother) to Mount & Blade. From what I've read these guys were modders for Warband, and that makes sense.  Surviving the wasteland is difficult. You need protection. You need to team up and you need to be part of a bigger group. It's unforgiving, but that's where this game shines. Recovering after a battle is hard work when you're a team of two.   Overall this is a very fun game and I look forward to seeing it evolve.

上一次玩战争前线还是好几个月前的事情了，如果再算上上次，那就得追溯到好几年前国服开服的时候。 游戏的特有元素主要有兵种，战场武改和滑铲（嘿嘿），复合层面的选项让战斗变得非常多元化，你可以拿着一把散弹穿行在小巷中崩死一个又一个的敌人，也可以隐藏在犄角旮旯做一个猥琐的狙击手（其实好像很多游戏都是这个样子的） 而战改（战斗改装），说实在的大多数时候并不是很常用，加上配件需要升级解锁，复杂的解锁程序使得新人和老人的配件差距巨大，当时在国服甚至于有专门的工作室来练全配件解锁账户（说实在的这个是真的过分了） 最后说说滑铲吧（笑），其实如果说战脸真正与众不同的地方，我觉得也只有这个滑铲是其他能趴能跳的fps独有的设计了（也可能还有我没玩到）它对战斗节奏的提升有着很大的帮助，只记得最早期的一个pvp图有个大楼顶层的地方，我一把新手散弹能占领那个楼顶整整一局——那种感觉说实在的还不赖，而滑铲则是这个过程中必须熟练使用的战术动作（虽然一个地雷也得上天） 啊不知不觉写了好多......自从国服倒闭之后还是总能想起这个游戏，因此在steam上看见的时候就又下了一次——虽然感觉好像还是以前的样子——但是为什么pve这么多了？新的pvp地图怎么玩出了cf的感觉（丢手雷对枪）？当然 对我来说最可怕的敌人只有一个——次元壁，稳定500ping左右的延迟对于一个快节奏的枪战射击来说基本上就不一定能打死人了。 然后打了几个小时，卸载删除 还是让我知道的那个战脸留在我的记忆里吧 嘛最后给个综合评分的话，这游戏5星制我愿意给4星，抠掉的一星是配件解锁和新地图设计（充分发挥你们的特色好不好，那种狭小而无遮拦的巷战和到处台阶的地方怎么滑来滑去躲子弹嘛 xD） ——————————————————————分割线———————————— 最后，看见好像出了很多皮肤枪我感觉很欣慰（哇当时在国服玩的时候一直在想这玩意这么良心怎么做到收支平衡的？） 给有能力入坑（肉身翻墙或者vpn）的玩家一点小提示（概念上的）。 新手武器的强度和那些后期解锁武器的强度差距不大（应该不大吧。。反正我没感觉出来），pve的时候只要枪法好会找掩体基本上没有打不过的敌人，还有就是pve切记不要莽太远（即便你是个拿散弹的也不要莽到敌人里面去），然后保持移动，这样即使后面刷怪也是他们追你，个人认为拉动ai的行为才是这类pve的生存之道。 另外看见有人吐槽重甲兵，那玩意其实并没有他说的只能2人打，如果你先把周围的其他小怪打干净，然后将重甲兵溜到一个附近有一定空间的地方，接下来迅速近身，贴着他做圆周运动，你会发现这个家伙的旋转速度并没有比你的冲刺速度更快，因此就算只有你一个人，实际上也可以在冲刺耗尽之前绕到他的正背后一次到两次，然而即使是慢走，其实也不会直接被它的旋转速度追上，所以完全有间隙回复体能，然后用你手里的武器不断打击他的背部弱点就可以了。 嘛，预祝各位游戏愉快，我回去玩我的warframe去了~

当我们学习一个打牌游戏的时候，我们在想些什么？我想刀牌是没有给我们一个很好的回答的。 由于金钱系统的引入和”血量“（你可以看成LP，奖品卡，或者其他的表示获胜条件的东西）的拆分，刀牌对于场面最优解的阐述是个人玩过的卡牌游戏中最为模糊的。这导致这东西对于大部分休闲玩家来说不太像一个TCG而更像一个……可互动的塔防游戏？！（抱歉我想不到什么好的形容词了）。不过随着游戏时长的增加和对卡池的记忆，大部分玩家在游戏经历中还是会学习到一些定势的最优解，从而使得游戏会更加的“一板一眼”一些，更像一个打牌游戏。 那么问题就是该如何让玩家爱上学习了。我一开始想的喷点是“预组既少且弱鸡而且泛用性差这个菜鸡互啄区不是我想要的菜鸡互啄区所以我拿头练牌啊（没错我就是被mtga和ptcgol惯坏了的白嫖玩家）！”然后我看了看大厅的几套牌，挠了挠头： “好像也没啥可喷的了。” 所以聪明的玩家们，有什么办法可以在传统TCG的运营基础上既能阻止工作室又能让白嫖玩家稍微爽上一爽不流失的那么多呢？（毕竟作为一个白嫖玩家掏了入场门票如果玩的人变少了没人陪我玩白嫖模式我也会很伤心的。）

I decided to wait until achieving the hardest-to-earn ending before writing this review. I regret not taking a screenshot for posterity, especially since I would now need to play another twelve or so hours to get another chance; in contrast to all the time loops you go through while exploring this take on Shakespeare's Hamlet, they really want you to feel like your choice of ending is both meaningful and irreversible, to the point that you've gotta start from scratch if you want to play again. But there's already a screenshot of it somewhere in the Community section, as well as a Youtube video of all the ending narrations, so that alleviated some of the bitterness...even if such flippancy about the cast's fate is more in-line with a villainous perspective.  Anyways! Elsinore is a fascinating experience. It ran mostly fine on my i3 core laptop, though for a couple of cinematic moments, the store page's suggested minimum of i5 would be preferred. The cast of characters are fascinating reinterpretations of their classic portrayals, with even the traitorous Claudius having some sympathetic moments. The gameplay, focusing more on conversation and manipulation than the item-gathering and combining of similar adventure titles, was mostly entertaining. There was decent difficulty in figuring out how different people react to the same rumor, though some reactions just make your other efforts seem wasted, and a myriad of developments that you could see play out as well as directly get involved in.  All in all, I would call this an experience worth sharing, even for those that aren't familiar with classic literature.

Short answer: I like this game a LOT.  Long answer: Although I may not have spent hundreds of hours on this game and haven't even tried all the characters (I just found a couple I liked and stuck with them, y'know?), I see very little wrong with this game. The biggest frustrations that aren't intentionally part of the experience are when you have a troll, your team leaves you behind, or a bug, but all of these issues are quite rare in my experience. The most frustrating parts of the game itself are the roaming enemies that can incapacitate you with a single hit and the bosses, but both become dramatically easier with experience and coordination between players.   There are plenty of different weapons with varying amounts of differences from one to the other for each of the characters, so with some trial and error you can find your favorite. Even though you get random items from the loot boxes, if you have the correct parts from scrapping obsolete or unwanted you can endlessly forge your favorite weapon at a strength that is appropriate to your character. Dodging, pushing, blocking, and knowing which type of attack to use are all important parts of the game as well! They help you minimize the damage you take and effectively combat the myriad types of enemies you will encounter. Dodging distance differs from character to character and what weapon you use determines the qualities of all of the other tecniques. For example: a one handed sword (or other lightweight weapons) will have fast light attacks, a mace (or other heavyweight weapon, including two handed ones) is good for piercing armor, weapons with shields are good for blocking and pushing, and two handed weapons will have strong heavy attacks.   The banter between the characters is also something I really enjoy, and it seems like there's always something I haven't heard before. It really brings life and personality to the characters that are typically just cleaving their way through hordes of enemies.  If you like PvE games, you will like this game. I enjoy it a lot, at the very least.
