The start of it all in the Science Adventure series. I never thought I'd give this title a shot after I watched the horrific anime adaptation years ago, but Chaos;Child really changed my mind. With the majority of what I watched forgotten about after I pushed it out of my memory, I went in to this as blind as could be after I had played Chaos;Child, and it was a great time. This visual novel is nowhere near perfect, but it's far from being bad. It's a good VN that suffers from some clunky story structure and literal game development problems, but it still delivers a satisfying journey to embark on with multiple interesting characters and events.  The biggest problem is the protagonist, Takumi. He is weak in many regards, so he's not all that fun to follow at times in the story. But his weakness is everyone else's gain, as the story, events, and characters that surround Takumi become interesting and engaging. So I'd say it all balances out. Other than that, I'd say that there's one or two other characters that just don't end up having much of a purpose in the end, which really bummed me out. One of them just gets used as everyone's punching bag in almost every route, which really stinks. But other than that, I have no complaints with the characters. While some are quirky and weird, they're still very enjoyable.  Similarly to Chaos;Child, this title has the same approach of having everything being confusing and hard to follow as you go through the story, up until when things get revealed at the end of the common route and in the character routes. It's fun trying to figure out what's happening even so many things seem extremely disjointed and not coherent whatsoever. At times I kinda just gave up and accepted that everything is just a chaotic mess, especially with the concept of delusions. But things do come together, and it's satisfying connecting the puzzle pieces at the end of the common route and in the following alternate/character routes.  Finally, the most shared complaint is how clunky and messy this game is. This title was actually shipped out broken, where many reported that they couldn't even view the final route's ending sequences, which prevented them from finishing the game! Luckily this was fixed with an update, but there are also other problems. You have to cap the game to 60fps to avoid animations being too quick, having certain USB controllers plugged in will freak the game out in menus, the font is terrible, there's no quotations around spoken dialogue, etc. It's also unfortunate that there is cut content shipped with this game. It's super depressing for a title that many in the Science Adventure community looked forward to having all of these issues.  There is a patch that fixes some of the problems I listed, however it changes the official translation to that of a fan translation. If you use this patch, you have to use the translation that a team of Science Adventure series fans put together, which is fine. There are names and such that have been changed for a variety of reasons as they expect you to always use their patches in all other Science Adventure titles. If you don't mind that, then you do get a better font, quotations on dialogue, and the return of cut content (specifically a collection of scenes that pop up in the alternate route after completing the common route, which isn't necessary to view, but preferred in my opinion). Either way, you can absolutely play the game with or without the patch, as both translations seem to be totally fine (they both tell the same story). I played the first ~6 chapters of the common route without the patch and the rest with it. It's quite obvious of there being some glaring changes in the fan translation, like the mentioned name changes, more cursing, more aggressiveness out of Takumi, and localized lines and more modern internet slang.  In the end, I'd say this is a visual novel everyone who enjoys VNs should try out. This is a great introduction to the Science Adventure series, and also the obviously preferred one, but Steins;Gate still works as a good alternative introduction to the series. While it may not be the strongest in the series, Chaos;Head Noah is absolutely worth the time and effort to figuring out the big question of... Whose Eyes Are Those Eyes? And hey, if you went through Chaos;Child first, no worries! You didn't spoil too much and there's still a wild adventure to embark on. Plus, it'll open your eyes to some new stuff that'll make going through Chaos;Child again worth it.  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R-xSUgGA5aE

Although I partially experienced the original DOOM 3 back when it was launched, only recently I came to admire and appreciate the marvelous products of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Id_Tech] id Tech [/url] iterations. Products, not product, because Ultimate DOOM, DOOM 2 and DOOM 3 (technological landmarks in the history of PC gaming) are bundled together in the package of DOOM 3: BFG Edition.   Ultimate DOOM and DOOM 2... yes, some of the wonders of the 90s generation games. You know what you get, no need for details here. If you are looking for a better experience with modern configurations, just grab the WAD files from the install directory structure and use them in GZDOOM. The soundtrack is an essential part of the experience, from E1M1's adrenaline-rush effect to the final of DOOM 2 ([spoiler] Map30 - Icon of Sin [/spoiler])... the somehow calming, but very disturbing [i] Woo - eee - woo - oooh [/i]. Almost forgot, but you also get the amazing addition of the No Rest For The Living episode.   DOOM 3 is a different approach to the series, being more interactive as using various Terminals, PDAs, Storage Lockers or PIN codes is the norm and a big selling point from my point of view. The weapons are nice, but feel a little bit weak compared to the originals series counterparts. I guess this was a design choice to contribute to the scary and occasional tension rising atmosphere. There are differences in the look and feel of DOOM 3 between the original release and the BFG Edition, but, to be honest, they are not game-breaking and you can experience whatever version you like as purchasing it will give you both versions, including the expansion, Resurrection of Evil, and even some Lost Mission goodies.  I really appreciate this DOOM 3: BFG Edition bundle for what it gives. Maybe nostalgia kicked in, but as started so goes the end, I can only display admiration and respect for the talented people who gave us the DOOM series.

Very dull so far. Everything is extra small on the Steam Deck screen, so it's hard to discern what things are. Even if the devs don't have a Steam Deck, they can put the game in 1280x800 resolution and see for themselves. The font is way too small, despite a giant text box. Walking speed is much too slow as well, making movement a chore. You can use the sickle on multiple things at once, but watering crops, cutting logs and mining rocks happen one by one. So you have to painstakingly ensure you're in the right position to till the right bit of land, and then water that one spot. It's tedious. I'm sure you can upgrade tools later, but it didn't make me want to keep playing.  So far all I've done is tidy the farm up a bit and wander slowly through town. The map shows characters with face icons. You won't know what characters look like when you just start, so I would have preferred an additional name list to find them. Your character appears as a gold sort of token on the map, making it tricky to work out where you are, especially when everything is ant sized. The map also doesn't clearly show you where places are when you click on the place name, it just shows the general area. Not very precise for a map.  This game needs more time in the oven, I think. Or at least some minor tweaks. Make everything larger, especially the text. Make the movement speed much faster, or add some kind of bike/vehicle. In terms of plot, nothing has happened that's been remotely gripping, but that could just be me. I find it telling that only 38% of players have gotten the achievement for level 5 in farming, which took me about 20 mins. Not currently recommended.

This game has blown away my perspective of what RPGMaker games can be. I've played a lot of them, some good, many bad, but none like this. The depth of content is second to none.  There are actual puzzles here, lots of them. From your standard 'move object into slot' to more complex jumping puzzles that will break your brain. As you explore you'll see many chests around, and it's often a puzzle in and of itself to figure out how to get to them. There are also quite a lot of minigames, including a whole little card game!  Speaking of exploration, the map in this game feels pretty darn huge. This small town has so many little crevices with dungeons, side stories and weird characters. I knew this game absolutely had me when I fought a rat called Julius Cheeser. I felt like I had a whole world to explore, if I wanted to. Or you can stay home and spend way too long arranging your home decor to your liking.  Notes from Province encourages you to talk to NPCs and rewards you for doing so. Either with information about a quest, or by adding to your Notes section about the character. As the story progresses, you'll get many Notes that you can read, and they're well written. You really get a sense that you're in a living village, especially as NPCs aren't static and move around. By some miracle in almost 20 hours of play, none of them impeded my path or were too hard to find.  The central plot isn't intially clear, as you're mainly exploring and getting to know people. But as you meet new party members and areas open up, you'll get more story content. I didn't love every party member, but I really liked how their companion stories unfolded. They start as normal sidequests and develop as actual stories. The writing paces the character development well, instead of just telling you that someone feels sad or powerful or whatever.  There are a few typos here and there, and I will admit the 'emo dude with a weird name walks through rain' intro didn't really grab me. But I'm so glad I didn't write it off that fast as it quickly became such a joy to explore. It reminded me of the game Ara Fell in that I felt compelled to see what was around each corner, and was consistently rewarded for my efforts.  Combat is much deeper than I expected for an RPGMaker game. Lots of buffs, debuffs, and each party member has a different combat style. It felt nuanced enough that I wasn't just button mashing. There were one or two boss fights that felt like they dragged on far too long [spoiler] monster in the underworld, prisoner at the end, and the final boss to be specific [/spoiler] but nothing too bad.  There are graphics here you'll have seen before if you've played other RPGMaker games. Like character portraits, monsters or general assets. What I was surprised by however were the unique locations that varied in design. Each cave had a theme, each dungeon distinct design elements. Locations like [spoiler] a fairy realm, an ice cave with magic lasers, a time tower, and an underworld just to name a few! [/spoiler] That attention to detail really sets this game apart from others using this engine. You can tell that the developer went above and beyond here to make the world feel alive.  Not sure how much of the music is stock or not, but I enjoyed it enough. Different areas have their own tracks so you don't have to listen to the same thing constantly. And there's a cute piano mini game which I quite enjoyed as well.  I firmly believe that this game shouldn't be free, but given that it is, play it. You've nothing to lose. I didn't expect to sink almost 20 hours in just a few days on a free RPGMaker game I stumbled across. But I'm just astounded by the quality of the writing, the humour, and the creativity shown in this game. And you can always buy the dlc if you feel like it. Highly recommended.  If you want to try other great RPGMaker games, I'd suggest the prior mentioned Ara Fell and a free (18+) game called The Last Sovereign. Notes from Province tops them both but all 3 will occupy you for some time.  The dlc developer notes mention that they spent several years on this game, and it was time well spent. I hope they continue to bring their talent to this medium and succeed in all aspects!

Más de 50 horas después llenas de acción, un poco de frustración (en la máxima dificultad y el último Boss Rush) y todos los logros desbloqueados, no me queda otra que recomendar esta joya.  Jugabilidad: Lo mejor del juego y de la saga en general es la fluidez con la que uno se mueve y ataca con el personajes, la respuesta a todos los comandos que introducimos tienen respuesta rápida, el personaje se desplaza a gran velocidad y reacciona instantáneamente a todo, el combate siempre se siente fluido  Duración: Lo justo y necesario para que te den ganas de rejugar en dificultades más altas, una primer partida puede durar alrededor de 8 horas  Dificultad: El juego es un reto desde la dificultad normal y en los niveles más altos requiere de aprender patrones y explotar cada segundo de debilidad de los enemigos, el mínimo error es un Game Over, sin embargo muy pocas veces el juego se llega a sentir injusto.  Rejugabilidad: El aumento de dificultad hace que un jefe que pudo parece fácil en la dificultad anterior empiece a requerir cada vez más estrategia no es solo un aumento de stats sino que a veces se acomplejan algunas habilidades.  Sonido: La música es típico rock épico al que nos tiene acostumbrados la empresa Falcom con esta saga, te llena de energía para seguir yendo de frente enfrentándote a todos los enemigos que te cruces.  Historia: No es nada de otro mundo pero teniendo en cuenta la duración del juego se sabe mantener a lo largo del mismo, nunca llega a ser una molestia.  Resúmen: YS: Oath Of Felghana es un ARPG con controles muy fluidos, pero una jugabilidad muy adictiva, uno puede pasarlo tranquilamente en fácil o proponerse un verdadero reto y sufrir en las dificultades más altas pero siempre sabiendo que todos los retos son superables.

Note: TLDR at the bottom. Apologies for the long review, I like to write. Across the Obelisk is a rogue-like strategy deck builder. I believe the best way to describe it is a mixture of Slay the Spire (card mechanics) and Darkest Dungeon (4-man party mechanic). Other similar titles being: Slay the Spire, Monster Train, Monster Slayer, Deck Hunter, NEOVERSE, Night of the Full Moon, Tainted Grail and Rise of the Slime.  I have played all of these games and without a shred of doubt, Across the Obelisk is the best one amongst them. If you haven't heard of all the other similar titles, I would recommend checking them out as well.  It is revolutionary in the sense that it is the first of its genre that allows seamless co-op up to 4 players, each player controlling a character. If there is not enough players, you can assign the remaining character(s) to a player and have them control multiple. If you start a run with one person, you can invite another person mid-game and have them assume control of a character without any loss of gear or progression made on that character prior to their arrival. Co-op is bug-free and well polished, highly unexpected from an early access game. Not to mention it has quite beautiful cartoon-like art, the monster designs are also very unique and cute and animations are smooth as butter.  On with what makes this vastly different from other games in the same genre (in my subjective opinion), is the fact that you can control 4 independent characters with their own decks. Slay the Spire only lets you have one deck on a run, and it was always best to try and collect cards that were all similar in effect (eg. collecting poison cards and stacking poison). If you deviate too much from your decks main purpose, it would ruin the efficiency of your deck and could cost you the run, But with Across the Obelisk, you also face this problem but it is far more forgiving.  The nodes on the map also involve RNG checks, for example, you can fight the enemies straight up, or you can try and ambush them and gain an edge or you can fail to ambush them and instead have them gain an advantage. There are many instances of risk and reward that can always change the dynamic of the run, and what characters you bring along can also impact the success rates of these RNG checks.   Despite these interesting features and mechanics, the game is still very difficult, especially if you're still in your first few runs, but the game does reward you with a chest at the end of your run with gold and shards to help you prepare for your next run. The progression system is also very well thought out, as you can level up your characters and assign perks to them that are permanent across all runs (you can also reset them for free and reassign them). What this means is that your party will be stronger on your second run in comparison to your first run. It is a breathtaking experience when you finally manage to complete the game, only to level up your party, unlock new characters just to do it all over again.   Across the Obelisk is a refreshing hidden gem in the genre of strategy deck-building games and I wished more people were aware of it. I actually bought it first and pressured my friends to play with me, surprisingly, they too enjoy the game despite being quite disinterested and hesitant at first. But this only comes to show that this game really is a marvel to play.  TLDR:  Across the Obelisk is a game that I'd say is revolutionary amongst its peers in the rogue-like strategy deck-building genre, its 4-man co-op feature and complex card mechanics, character and progression system are very polished well beyond expectations despite being an Early Access game. It is a mixture of Slay the Spire and Darkest Dungeon bundled up in one game. It poses quite a challenge when first starting but eventually, it does get easier as your characters become stronger and the more you play, the more you understand that can help you for future runs. Give it a shot! Because I did, and here I am, writing a review for it +50hrs later

So picture this, it's 2019. Dark Souls 3 is getting tiring and PVP is getting stale; you've already played the game many times over and want something new. BAM! Elden Ring teaser drops and you are blown away by it's majesty. Let's just say that wasn't the only thing that was blown that day. Apparently, there was also a bombing in Cairo, Egypt.  Elden Ring is pretty much like Dark Souls but on crack. They somehow raised the bar with this game up to the point where I may never be able to play an open world game the same.. Everything is great from an offline standpoint and honestly gets a 9/10 but better than Dark Souls 3 for sure.  Multiplayer is a bit rough.  The servers tend to just suck or something because as soon as you summon or get summoned, you have a high chance of being disconnected and it ruins invading/ganking from a PVP standpoint. I don't hate it but I feel like it's pretty much the same experience I had with Dark Souls 3 multiplayer, which made it tedious and essentially forced my hand to play offline for a bit.  Aside from the multiplayer, the game and story itself is beautiful and tragic. The art design is so intriguing, there are some areas in the game that genuinely sent shivers down my spine as if I'm playing a horror game. The sound uses similar sounds to Dark Souls 3 ( I have a sneaking suspicion that this game is using the same engine as it ) though they weren't bad; I for one just didn't feel moved by them. Voice acting is good in this game I love the different accents between all the characters. One thing I'll point out is that, if you don't like open world games or don't have the time to put it in I would suggest playing any of the Dark Souls series because even though this is a good game to get started with it is a heavy time consumer.  Elden Ring is a [h1] 8/10 [/h1]  I know I said the game from an offline standpoint is 9/10 but the multiplayer with some other nitpicks kind of soil some of the experience that the player should be given. Still an amazing game and I recommend full price.

O mundo de New World é muito bonito, pvp rasoável e o sistema de craft poderia ter sido bastante decente. E isso é tudo o que o jogo tem de positivo.  Não existem variedade de inimigos, você enfrenta exatamente os MESMOS inimigos do level 1 ao level 60, sempre com padrões de ataques iguais, inclusive os animais predadores espalhados pelo jogo, os inimigos são apenas recoloridos ou tem uma skin levemente diferente um do outro.  O mesmo acontece com o mundo de New World, que apesar de bonito, tem muitos lugares iguais, basicamente um control c/control v espalhado por todo o continente.  As builds são simples e limitadas, você investe seus pontos no atributo primário da arma que você joga, simples assim, e o nível de customização da árvore de habilidades de arma é mínimo, quase não dando espaço pra diversidade de gameplay, o que, na minha opinião, faz com que as guerras e pvp 1v1, tambem se tornam tediosas em pouco tempo.  O sistema de craft poderia ter sido um grande trunfo do game, no começo é divertido coletar itens durante seus longos passeios pelo mapa, e craftar algo logo quando chega na cidade, porem logo voce percebe que o sistema de craft só é realmente impactante nos seus níveis mais altos, tudo abaixo disso só gera gasto de gold e tempo, sem retorno, isso porque é muito fácil dropar os itens de que vc precisa, e se não dropar, você pode simplismente comprar no mercado por um valor extremamente baixo, pois a economia do New World esta ainda mais estranha agora devido aos exploits de duplicação de gold tardiamente resolvido pela Amazon. Sim, New World esta recheado de bugs tambem.  New World é mais um dos diversos fracassos no mundo dos mmorpgs.

Review Update - September 2022  No Man's Sky is definitely one of my favorite games. Even after 500+ hours, there are still things to explore and Hello Games is still actively developing the game. But of course, NMS also has its flaws. Gonna list a few things NMS does good and some... not so good...  [u]Good things:[/u] ● ...a seemingly infinite universe to explore ● ...a huge selection of starships, freighters & flee-ships ● ...the option to upgrade low-tier weapons/ships to the highest tier ● ...base-building [i](always a plus in my books)[/i] ● ...seasons, which are designed for beginners & veterans ● ...really nice crafting system ● ...the ability to build farms and not only rely on your mining laser ● ...interesting quests [i](depending on ones personal taste of course)[/i] ● ...a community hub with community missions ● ...VR support  [u]Not so good things:[/u] ● ...planets, fauna & flora get a bit repetitive after a while ● ...currently no way to modify the looks of your starships ● ...you will encounter some odd glitches, so make sure to save regularly ● ...the early grind can feel a bit unrewarding ● ...some older systems might experience some technical issues [i](I had to modify graphic settings via notepad++ in the NMS folder)[/i]  [u]Conclusion:[/u] If you like exploration, base-building & collecting starships, No Man's Sky is the game for you! NMS has a lot of content now [i](compared to launch)[/i] and with each new update comes a new season, which is the ideal to start playing. Veterans get a new experience and new players get a little push. Also, you can keep your season character after you've finished the season. I can highly recommend No Man's Sky!

在这款游戏里，你可以用这些轰鸣的钢铁巨兽和铁轨连接不同的城市和乡村，收购不同的领地和工厂等来丰富自己公司的产业结构，使自己的公司不只有铁路。我比较喜欢采用的策略是买债券，买股票还有并购自己竞争对手这样商业层面的事，甚至有一次买了很多债券后直接将自己的竞争对手并购，再一点点挣钱还债。等把所有的城市并入自己的铁路网后，你就真的建立了一个“铁路帝国”。因为这款游戏的背景与美国历史有关，我知道太平洋铁路是美国历史上比较著名的一段铁路，横跨了北美洲，所以你还可以或多或少感受一下铁路在美国历史中发挥的作用。我叫这款游戏小文明，但整体给人感觉是很休闲的，不像文明系列那样每次停不下来。  ~~~~~~ 看到日本DLC之后很久没有新的DLC了，就用了一些时间把全成就打完了，虽然为了完成任务大多数玩的都是铁路网通常模式，但是我觉得自己在建铁路方面已经炉火纯青了。做的最好的一个任务我觉得是，美国西部1850“淘金热”的剧本，因为卡森城、沙士达山、旧金山三座城市有和人口相关的建筑，会随着人口的增多得到更多财富，所以游戏主要是发展这三个城市，因为萨克拉门托恰好处于这三个城市中间，所以到了游戏的中期，我的萨克拉门托人口发展到了50万，让我爽了一把，还需要提的一点是，这个任务和澳洲精神一样由于初始资产和对手数目没法选择，所以想要评分达到30分总经理评级，需要暂停模式选择为火车狂。

This is a relaxing game. For me this game is most similar to balloon tower defence.   There are a large number of well designed units each with distinct features. Also like that positioning units higher gives more range. Also the game is very fair in that you can sell units at purchase cost. Which allows for easier unit aggregation.  I did enjoy the game and found it a good way to do something simple during a break, which is how I chipped away at the game until all levels were completed.  Since I did spend a bit time, I did start wishing for features that I feel are needed in a subsequent version. 1) The game is mostly set and forget (this does make the game relaxing). There isn't unit triggerable abilities. It would make it more interesting to have something to do during a level. 2) The shop is pretty good, but I have a lot of crystals at the end of the game with nothing to buy. Maybe add some more nice to haves, reach goals. 3) The levels while interesting in the themes don't feel rewarding. It would be nice if you unlocked something at the end of finishing the level, a unit perhaps, or even the right to buy something in the shop. Like in the winter level you could see objects to pickup on the map that unlock slow level II or III. This would give the map more meaning.  4) In the shop you can unlock buffs but I find it a bit annoying that unlocking a buff that slows means that it always costs more, it would be nice it you could apply the 1gp, 2gp, 3gp, ect buff rather than the buff at only the higher price.  5) Unit strategies become repetitive, it might be nice if certain levels make some units unavailable, or perhaps add a restriction that you can't use a certain set of units for full level completion.   6) Some selection operations (coins, units at the edge) can be tricky. Might be nice to add 6dof (rotation, zoom, pan) so we can see the map better.  I know I mentioned a few areas where I feel there could be improvement but for the cost of the game and for hours I got out of it think it is good return (even at a 1/4 of the hours)!  I hope the series continues!

This game is good. But that does not mean it is great.  The only reason I started playing this game is b/c my friends eventually convinced me to play it. I have never been a big fan of mmorpgs, but I am a huge rpg and jrpg ennjoyer. I really like numbers and when they go up or you complete achievements it is very fun. I also like a good challenge in games, whenever I am playing a game I usually play on hard mode b/c that is how I enjoy them. This game has these - but not perfected.  You can level up your equipment by killing monsters, pvping, gathering and crafting. The beginning of this is extremely slow, so slow to the point where I did not gather and only crafted once I could buy my materials with large sums of silver. But once you do get past the very slow start of the game is where it got even more fun. The only thing I enjoyed in this game was pvping with my friends, we would go out in open world and win insane fights, 3v10s 3v5s etc. There is a large amount of skill and you can out skill your opponents if you play better, but that gets destroyed by the item power system. If your oppenents have more IP than you and outnumber you, it is extremely hard to win. In order to get to this point you have to dump several hours into just farming to get more skills and wear better equipment, this might not be worth it to you. This part of the game was very addicting to me, you can loot the people that you killed and sell that for more of your own gear or invest it into other things. The reason I say was, is b/c I am completely burnt out. I do not enjoy the pvp currently and am not sure if I ever will. It got up to the point where you see the same people with similar skill levels and it felt like a 50/50 chance to win or die, especially when I did 2v2s with my friends.   All in all - If you can get past a slow start and like to pvp this game is very addicting and rewarding(from my perspective).

Stray ist ein Wahnsinnig tolles Spiel, was nicht nur für Liebhaber von Katzen interessant ist! :3  Grafisch und Sound-technisch ist das Spiel sehr gut geworden. Die Farben im Spiel sind stimmig, die Reflexionen passen sehr gut rein und der Soundtrack rundet die allgemeine Atmospähre im Spiel wunderbar ab, finde ich.  Die Story ist sowohl spannend, als auch sehr rührend an einigen Stellen. Ich liebe auch das Konzept mit der Katze, dass ich so noch nie gesehen hab. Man kann auch viele Dinge machen, die eine Katze auch im echten Leben machen würde, was sehr gut funktioniert! Generell ist die Katze als Hauptcharakter einfach nur ein neues, ungewöhnlich gutes Erlebnis.  Ich liebe auch die kleinen versteckten Details und Easter Eggs, die überall eingebaut wurden (*Hust Skyrim *Hust) :D  Und dafür, dass es das erste Spiel vom unabhängigen Entwickler BlueTwelve Studio ist, geht die Spielzeit von knapp 6-10 Stunden absolut in Ordnung. Wenn man alle Achievements und Collectables finden will, kommt vielleicht auch auf mehr. Trotz der Spielzeit ist das Storytelling im Spiel mMn. nicht zu schnell und schafft es dennoch, eine gute Verbindung mit den Figuren in der Welt von Stray aufzubauen. (Andere haben da vielleicht eine andere Meinung, für mich war das Storytelling so genau richtig ^^)  Die Performance von Stray geht absolut in Ordnung. Ich hatte lediglich ein paar kleine Bugs, die aber nicht weiter schlimm waren und auch nicht den Spielfluss gestört haben. Wenn man das mal mit gewissen anderen Spielen der letzten Monate vergleicht, ist das wirklich nichts im Vergleich dazu :D  Noch ein kleiner SPOILER zum Ende:  Der letzte Abschnitt ist zwar vielleicht ein klein wenig zu kurz geraten und es wird leider noch nicht alles aufgeklärt (z.b. ob die Katze ihre Familie nach der Öffnung der Stadt wiedersehen wird), aber abseits davon war es eine emotionale Achterbahnfahrt. Allein beim letzten Dialog mit B-12 und bei dem was danach geschah, musste ich mich echt hart zusammenreißen, um nicht das Weinen anzufangen. T_T  Wer weiß, vielleicht erscheint in Zukunft ja noch ein Nachfolger oder ein DLC, was dann die restlichen Fragen aufklärt. Vielleicht wurde es im Spiel an einigen Stellen sogar schon angeteasert, wer weiß :D  Auf jeden Fall gibt`s von mir eine klare Kaufempfehlung für das Spiel! ^^

我以為Gun Club應該就是VR操作槍枝的極限了，原來是我玩的遊戲太少... 這遊戲本質上就是一個沙盒遊戲，加上作者自己設定的模式有不少的玩法，但是大部分時間會是享受在靶場自由操作各種槍枝的樂趣，而光是這樣子我居然過了5個小時才第一次拿下VR頭盔  一個一個慢慢說 槍聲、手感、後座力：槍聲很爽！不會像其他VR遊戲一樣像是罐頭一樣，這是真的有魄力且收音清楚的槍聲，就連散彈裝進去會有跟彈倉的共鳴聲都有　手感上後座力的調度很好，不會像Gun Club或VRC裡面的靶場沒有發射的感覺，槍枝的動畫與各個槍枝有設定不同的上跳幅度，甚至是雙手握持、抵肩、使用握把等等都會降低改善後座力與更好的手感。  槍枝多樣性與超細節： 這遊戲從燧發槍到一戰，二戰到未來的槍枝都有，不怕你想不到，只怕你不懂怎麼操作，因為每把槍叫出來都是保險開著，而且沒有裝彈匣。 手槍可以雙持！雙持之下不知道怎麼填彈，這遊戲居然可以給出，只要現實能夠做到的理論，在VR裡面也會盡善盡美──先是雙槍卸匣之後再一手各裝上匣，上膛的時候直接把兩邊的滑套互頂上膛。 衝鋒槍：光是MP5系列就有20幾種...我的老天，你可以很輕易的做到HK SLAP，只要手柄判定在槍機拉柄附近就會上膛，不必按任何案件，AR系列的網球拍也是如此，所以能在現實中做流暢的上彈。 步槍、突擊步槍：只要是現實中可以餵的彈匣，兩把槍之間也有互調性，像是AR之間，越戰的M16也可以從M4A1的P-MAG戰術彈匣中拿來使用。  而AK系列的像是以前的AK74，也可以跟現在AK10X系列的羅馬尼亞彈匣通用！當然像是SCAR、L85之類的槍，都可以這樣玩，操作性高與樂趣十足，如果想要戰術換匣的話，拿新彈匣的時候在舊彈匣旁邊按退彈紐，就可以實現一手握兩匣，然後把舊的彈匣回收；當然像是拿著AK把原本槍上的彈匣給敲開之類的戰術換彈那是一定有的。  狙擊槍：絕對沒有人想要在VR裡面用手栓式狙擊槍，但是這遊圖，所以真的瞄準的時候也是左眼搜尋目標，右眼精準狙擊，不管是反射、全息、高倍率都能自得其樂，完全不會想要用到雷射外戲，H3它做到了，手栓式的快感非常好，操作準確的關係，很容易就分清楚哪裡是拉柄，哪裡是板機，不會有判定錯邊的情形發生。 這遊戲的瞄準鏡是真的模擬光學去做出來的，不像其他VR遊戲是做貼紅點。  霰彈槍：散彈應該是最讓我驚豔的地方了吧，除了剛剛說到裝彈有一些共振音很爽之外，第一發可以先從拋殼口裝彈殼，第二發開始再換成從彈殼裡面裝進彈倉也可以！你會很享受彈殼一顆一顆裝的過程！像是M1987的話，只要扣住板機，不斷的拉動滑套就會一直射擊，很還原；沒錯！像是槓桿式的話可以把槍想成一個木棒，有兩種方式，第一種是直接把Lever下拉，普通的讓彈殼拋出進彈，另一種則是電影跟遊戲常見到的轉槍，雙手握住槍之後做轉圈圈的動作，跟現實一樣把整個槍轉一圈，這種發射方式也會成立，超有滿足感！  機槍之類的操作則是真的要把上蓋打開來→裝上彈鼓→把彈鍊拿出來→蓋回上蓋→拉柄→開保險。  一些完全要槍枝愛好者才能知道的細節：像是AUG、P90這些槍枝，單連發是板機是整合的，所以跟現實世界一樣，輕壓是半自動單發，用力壓到底是全自動連發，還有很多槍枝的操作不會有說明，但是會是按照現實的方式操作，所以不懂怎麼做的話可能就要上Youtube看真槍操作怎麼做，或是回想以前的玩的FPS遊戲在裝彈匣時的動作。  對於英文苦手或對槍枝不是那麼熟悉的人這遊戲有點難上手，但是相信我，只要是愛好者絕對會在假日好好的在靶場玩上一下午解悶，PEACE！

As a whole? Very rough and feels like an alpha. Full of bugs even after the patches (granted there's visible improvement) and completely chock-full of jank. Not surprising considering the development hell around this game and the cut content. You'll be smooth sailing one day and the next you'll clip through walls or have gigs be completely unable to be completed. Difficulty options mean nothing other than bullet-sponge enemies and AI that can one shot you, which by the way is never difficult, only tedious and conditions you to abuse med-kit inhalers so you don't have to reload a save (no different than something like Fallout 4 really). Furthermore, the clothing/ armor system means jack in the end since you play in the first-person the whole game, and even then you'll pick clothes based off substance over style (the opposite of what it preaches). There comes a point in the game where money means nothing anymore as you already spent it all on stuff you actually want, meaning all subsequent gigs are done just for the sake of it and not for any other reason.   With all my gripes out of the way... underneath the veil? This game brings up many interesting concepts and attempts to run with it. Unfortunately its plagued by chronic missed potential syndrome and some of the best parts of the game are promptly dropped and the burning questions left over aren't answered. The main story and the side quests have some good story-telling behind it, though that was expected coming from the devs of The Witcher 3. The voice-acting and writing makes many of the key characters feel alive, especially when they text you and warm up to you and you can really get attached to them. I also really like how Cyberpunk attempts to emulate the 80s Blade Runner aesthetic, with many parts of the city looking like its straight out of the movie.  Despite the numerous problems, I think its a really decent game. Get it on sale and you'll get quite a bit of enjoyment out of it. I truly believe it would've been one of the best games to ever be released had it been delayed and had put more work in, so its really too bad it was released in the state that it was.

PLEASE help and support this amazing educational indie game, I promise it deserves your time!!!  In late December 2007, my life was changed forever when the demo for a new non-profit game went live.  When I hit the 'Download' button, a little educational application called WolfQuest was installed to my family's crappy Dell PC that would spark a passion in me that burns to this day. Produced as part of a collaboration between a tiny game development company called Eduweb and the Minnesota Zoo, this game was meant to educate players on the lives of wild wolves in Yellowstone National Park, here in the USA. It was funded by a grant from the National Science Foundation and thus was free to play for anyone with a computer. The developers consulted with wildlife biologists and worked incredibly closely with the world's best wolf researchers to create the most accurate experience they possibly could. As a result, this little demo developed a small cult following that, through word of mouth alone, blossomed into a thriving community of nature lovers young and old.  After learning of the project on a role play forum for the Warrior Cats books, I had been following the development since the day the game had been announced. I cannot begin to tell you how many hours I spent in front of my computer screen playing solo, and when multiplayer finally came out, I found friends who not only understood me but shared my love for these incredible animals. I have followed the development of this game religiously ever since. It is a major part of my development as a human being and I am not ashamed to admit that. In fact, if it wasn't for the escape from traumatic events I was suffering through that WolfQuest provided, I truly believe I probably would not be here to write this. As a child with undiagnosed autism, I needed that escape more than anything.  The full story of the game's history is too long for me to include in detail here. However, I can't overstate how much it has changed since that first demo dropped. Development continued from 2007 until the release of version 2.5 in October 2011, when the grant's funding finally ran out. Yet the game remained in the hearts and minds of the developers — primarily Dave Schaller, the director and producer. Despite the lack of funding, Dave and his small team of about a dozen people intended to continue working on it as soon as they could afford to.  In 2015, WolfQuest 2.7 (now known as WolfQuest Classic) was released seemingly out of nowhere. Because the new, full version of the game was $10, Eduweb finally had enough consistent funding to pick up where they left off. While new content was added regularly, the game was also ported to mobile devices, which made the game absolutely explode in popularity. On top of this, they held and continue to hold monthly raffles to get a free copy of the game. The fandom went absolutely nuts over all of this — despite four years of no news and no updates, the community had remained active, and for the first time in as many years, a flood of new fans burst onto the scene. Development of WQ 2.7 came to a grinding halt, however, due to an announcement that would change everything.  In 2017, for the 10th anniversary of the first demo release, Eduweb announced WolfQuest: Anniversary Edition. They had been pulling in enough money from the previous version to begin development on a complete and total remake of the entire game that not only expanded gameplay mechanics but doubled the size of both main game maps. WQ:AE updated every single model, texture, effect, sound, and even the music to greet the latest generation of PC gamers. The game is now available on Steam and Itchio for $20, and with overwhelmingly positive reviews, it's worth every penny.  The game is now the most accurate, realistic, and detailed wildlife simulator on the market, and it will only keep getting better. On December 31, 2021, Dave Schaller showed footage of a radical change to the game. Previously, each season of the player wolf's life was limited to one map; the map for finding a mate in late autumn was Amethyst Mountain, the map for claiming a territory and having your pups was Slough Creek, etc. That has been the case for over 15 years. In 2022, the game will be making another massive leap forward into realism -- a complete restructure of the game's story that will make all maps available in all four seasons. They will no longer be limited by individual chapters; instead, your wolf could spend their entire life in one map, starting by finding a mate and raising litter after litter of pups there... or, if you're more interested in exploring, you'll also be able to travel between maps at any time. The future of WolfQuest is bright, and I have never been more excited.  Ever since I was 10 years old, WolfQuest has been the foundation for my #1 special interest: wolves, their behavior, their habitats, and their conservation. I have dedicated years of my life to learning everything I can about these animals; I own every book published on the subject in the last 30 years, I've interacted with real wolves in person, and I've run myself ragged advocating for the reintroduction of the gray wolf to their former ranges.  In 2020, my dream was finally realized when Proposition 114 was passed in Colorado. Prop 114 requires the state of Colorado to develop and implement a plan to reintroduce a population of gray wolves to my beloved state, where wolves have been extinct since 1945. By 2023, a reintroduction program will be established and begin moving forward so that at last, we can return this ancient howl to the Colorado Rocky Mountains.  I know this was a long read, but I truly hope it helps you understand how special this game is. It is one of a kind. It has one of the most passionate, enthusiastic fanbases I have ever seen. It has grown into something 10 year old me would never have imagined. This game is being created by experienced individuals with a solid creative vision who, for the past 15 years, have worked tirelessly to create the most scientifically accurate wildlife simulation game of all time. A little game released for free for anyone who was interested has become a masterpiece, and I am hoping that something in my review here has made you consider purchasing this game and donating to their cause on Fundly. Your money will be going to a small developer and will help educate the public on the true nature of one of the most misunderstood species on the planet. If that's not something to howl about, then I don't know what is.  Thank you for reading. Sorry this review is so long, but this project is deeply important to me, and I hope with time, it will be to you as well.

No kde bych začal, když jsem si hru zakoupil ležela mi asi měsíc v knihovně. Brouzdal jsem večer po Steamu a všiml si že mám tuto hru v knihovně, tak si říkám, okay, why not, let's give it a try. Hru jsem nainstaloval spustil a hned v úvodní obrazovce a v menu na dolehl pocit že to bude dost možná super hra, jelikož mne ošálil soundtrack, úvodní znělka v menu. Hra začínala jako většina post-apo zombie her, ale dlouho jsem si tento pocit neudržel. Když jsem se dostal přes úvodní cutscény a vysvětlení, co děláme v téhle pekelné díře s naším brachem Boozerem. Cutscény jsou opravdu pěkně nadizajnované, plynulé, graficky se jedná o rozhodně nádherný titul. Příběh mne na začátku nějak nechytl, až déle ve hře mne to absolutně vtáhlo do hry, otevřený svět, tábory, loot, random události jako bezbranní civilisté, které můžete zachránit a poslat do jednoho z táborů. Tohle vše včetně vylepšení motorky, craftingu a rozdělováním perkpointů dělá hru velice zábavnou a budete na ni doslova závislí. Dokonce jsem si chtěl vzít v práci volno bych hru mohl dohrát na jeden zátah, takhle silný příběh tato hra má. Točíte se kolem čtyř táborů, takže rozhodně nepostáváte na jednom místě pořád dokola. Vybírat lokace NERO nebo lovit zvěř má také svůj smysl, ne jen že něco zabijete, za maso a uši nakažených mátě peníze v daném táboře a jejich důvěru, díky tomu si můžete upgradeovat motorku, nebo nakoupit pro Deacona nějakou pořádnou pušku. Hlavní zápletka se kterou se seznámíte již na začátku hry je opravdu chytlavá a táhne se až do konce hry, i když vám to možná na první pohled nepřijde. Konec příběhu a jeho vyvrcholení bylo trošku slabší než jsem očekával, ale i tak jsem si to velice užil. V menu můžete nalézt tkz. výzvy, jsou tam třeba závody na motorce, nebo likvidace hordy v určitém čase. Za splnění získáte prsteny a badge které můžete využít v hlavní hře, jako bonusy k vaší postavě.  Už se těším až budu moct hru dohrát znovu, upřímně bych si na ni nejradši vymazal vzpomínky a hrál ji znovu na first feel, je to fakt ultimátní zážitek pro ty, kteří mají rádi příběhovky. Rozhodně doporučuji. :)  Grafika 10/10 Hratelnost 9/10 (ovládání motorky je v nějakých případech malinko nepřirozené) Soundtrack 10/10 Obsah otevřeného světa 9/10 (mohlo by být více táborů a hord, ale to je čistě můj úsudek) Příběh a chování vedlejších postav 10/10 Crafting a vylepšování motorky 8/10 (chtělo by to více možností upgradu motorky nebo Deacona) Zbraně 8/10 (menší paleta zbraní, elitním se dostanete ke konci hry, méně reálná fyzika a zvuky) Táborový systém hry 8/10 Po dokončení misí pro určitý tábor se tábor nějak nezmění, nevylepší, je pořád stejný ať už uděláte všechny mise či vozíte táboru zásoby masa, vzhled se bohužel nějak nemění. Hlavní zápletka a její vyvrcholení 9/10 (trošku slabší konečný ''boss fight'' ale nakonec to končí dobře :) )  Moje konečná známka je 9.7 bodů z 10 Hra má svoje mouchy, ale ty nejsou tolik zásadní, pokud vás příběh vtáhne stejně jako mne tak si hru nad rámec užijete. :)

[h1]Overview[/h1] Dark Souls 1 is one of the greatest games and a must play for everyone. This game has this reputation for being the pinnacle of difficulty in gaming. However, that is not the case at all. Dark souls is different It respects your intelligence and there is little hand holding. There are no minimaps or objective markers you are just left to explore. This can be foreign and overwhelming at first but you will come to understand that this is what makes the sense of adventure unmatched. The atmosphere of the world is also great with a notable lack of soundtrack in some areas where your just left to listen to your footsteps as you venture forward. There is also the incredible architecture and views that really add to the tone. The inspiration form Berserk by author Kentaro Miura is awesome to see as a huge fan. The coop multiplayer aspect is awesome and PvP is also very enjoyable if you are into that sort of thing.  [h1]Gameplay[/h1] The gameplay is also very different from other games. The attacks are weighty and not instant. When you choose to attack there is a windup phase and you cannot cancel your attack. The enemies also have to wind up to their attack so you can anticipate and dodge out of the way or block with a shield in your left hand. You can also parry with your shield to put your enemies in a vulnerable state. While the gameplay is not the most in-depth the build variety and amount of weapons and spells there are to experiment with is what really makes combat special.  [h1]World and enemies[/h1] Dark Souls 1 is constantly praised for its incredible world design. You will go on a huge adventure and then find an elevator that leads back to a previous bonfire as a shortcut. You'll come across a gate and it won't open only for you to be on the other side of that gate in 10 hours and unlock it for a shortcut. There are so many moments like this due to the world being so interconnected. But without enemies and bosses to match it the world would be nothing. But fear not, the enemies and bosses are fantastic. The quite diverse cast of enemies and bosses makes it so you never know what to expect in the next area you venture towards.   [h1]Soundtrack[/h1] Every single boss theme is amazing. Some are crazy and intense others are sad and melancholic. The area soundtracks like firelink and ash lake are beautiful. The soundtrack is a perfect fit and executed to perfection.  [h1]Story and Lore[/h1] While not shoved in your face and you can have a great time ignoring it the whole game I found myself intrigued and questioning what's going on. It is vague and fragmented and that is what I love about it. This is one of the few games I have found myself reading up on and watching hours of lore content to gain a greater understanding of this rich world.   [h1]Critiques[/h1] A fall off of quality in the latter half especially lost Izalith. Eight direction rolling when locked on would have been cool.  Bed of Chaos could be the worst boss of all time. Reuse of some enemies and bosses. Backstabbing being overpowered especially in PvP.  [h1]Conclusion[/h1] Maybe the reason Dark Souls 1 is my favorite of all time is the fact that it was my first From Software game. It really invoked a feeling of accomplishment that helped me a lot. You can give up whenever you want but that is when you've truly lost. It has impacted my life in so many ways it's hard to put into words. It leaves you looking for another game that can replicate a feeling like this. I love this game so much and the best part is that it doesn't stop here. You can go on to play Dark Souls 2 and 3, Bloodborne, Demons Souls, Sekiro, and the upcoming Elden Ring. These games are so much more than just a hard action RPG and I hope more people can realize that.

Firstly, the game is filled with bugs which sometimes may cause the player to reload the level. One of the most annoying bugs that i experienced in my play through was when an in game character name Joe would get stuck running against boxes during a mission that he must follow you or you cannot proceed. Also during gunfights occurring inside buildings my FPS would drop from 165 to 30 and would not go back up until I had left the area. The controls on this game are also extremely unintuitive and annoying to use making the game play not feel fun to actually play.  If you compare this game to the first Mafia's Definitive Edition you can see how little work was put into this game. It would have been great if the developers gave this game the same treatment. The games DLC's also leave alot to be desired as they are basically boring missions where you must destroy vehicles or shops which is not very fun game play.  I originally planned to complete all the achievements on this game like I had on Mafia 1 Definitive Edition, however playing through the DLC's I realised how much i was not enjoying playing the game and how annoying the missions were, therefore i stopped and installed the game, as if you are not having fun doing something then there is no point in doing it.  I had high hopes for this game after playing through Mafia 1 but i cannot bring myself to play it in the shape that it is. Rogue-lite FPS olarak oynanabilecek en iyi yapımlardan birisi olan Gunfire Reborn'da geçirdiğim her dakika çok zevkliydi. Gerek düşman tipleri, boss fightları, atmosferi, silah çeşitliliği ve karakter sayısıyla sizi tatmin edeceğinden emin olabilirsiniz. Her öldüğünüzde kazandığınız özlerle kendinizi güçlendirebilir ve yapacağınız yeni maceralarda daha güçlü geri dönüşler yapabilirsiniz.   Oyunda başta ki amacınız mümkün olduğunca öz kasıp seviye atlamak. Yetenek ağacınız ne kadar dolu olursa o kadar güçlü olur ve daha çok zevk alırsınız. Benden tavsiye hemen kazandığınız özlerle karakter açmayın onun yerine yetenek ağacınızı güçlendirin ondan sonra karakterlere yönelin.   Dürüst olmak gerekirse bazen zindan gezerken sıkılıp birden çıkabilirsiniz. Normalde toplu yani 4 kişi oynamaya iten bir yapım olan Gunfire Reborn fiyatıyla maalesef bu ülkede herhangi bir arkadaş ortamında herkesin bunu alması mümkün değil. Tek başınıza oynamayı pek tavsiye etmem ama şans vermek istiyorsanız bu oyun türünde oynayabileceğiniz iyi yapımlardan birisidir.

Bu tarz yapımları oynamış biri olarak söylüyorum ki aralarında oynadığım en kötü minimalist şehir kurma oyunu olduğunu söyleyebilirim. O kadar başarısız ki ne düzgün çeşitlilik var ne de yanlış bir şey koyunca silebileceğim bir tuşu var kısaca en önemli şeyler yer almaması oyunu daha baştan bitiriyor. Fiyatı uygun diye de elbette bunlar olmayabilir demek büyük yanlış olur. 6 TL hadi ciddi rakam değil ama böylesine bir yapıma vermenizi kesinlikle tavsiye etmiyorum.

Handshakes, orta-kolay zorluğa sahip 29 seviyesi olan ücretsiz çerez bir yapım. Amacımız 2 karakterimizin ellerini kullanarak bulmacaları çözüp tamamlamasına yardımcı olmak. Bunu yaparken belirli yerlerde beyin fırtınası yapmak ve düzgünce hareket etmek çok önemli. Çünkü bazı yerlerde en ufak hatanız seviyeyi tekrar başlatmanıza ve ufak sinir krizi geçirmenize sebep olur.  Oyunu bitirdiğiniz zaman speedrun modu açılmakla beraber bütün başarımları açmak istiyorsanız, ufak ezber yaparak oyunu hızlıca 10 dakika içinde tekrardan bitirebilirsiniz. Oynanış mantığı oldukça hoş olan Handshakes'e 10 üzerinden 9 veriyor ve bedava çerez yapım arayanlara şiddetle tavsiye ediyorum.    🤝

翻了一下没找到汉化补丁，但是其实单词都挺简单的，高考英语水平基本就可以很顺畅地阅读了~ 因为很喜欢《Fran Bow》所以也下载了这款，玩了下发现和前作玩法大相径庭，这并不是一款解谜剧情游戏，整体是一个线性叙事的剧情游戏。画面比前作要精致许多了，Misfortune真的超级可爱！！从小孩的天真烂漫角度去看的大人世界，即使这个世界如此肮脏，可爱的小女孩也能够用她的“魔法”让一切都变得美好起来，旅途的各处都把主角塑造得立体且温暖。 美中不足的是流程很短，很快就能通关，而且每处选择也对结局并没有什么影响，只是会关联到一些后续事件的发生，所以玩法上显得有些单一，单纯地变成类似于可动漫画一样的存在，如果像奇异人生或者采石场惊魂一样可以多点选择影响结局就好了，故事的结局有一些仓促，末尾的小高潮部分也有点过于短暂潦草。总得来说建议打折购入。 看得出来主创想要丰富前作的世界观，这让人很欣慰，希望后续制作的游戏更加优秀~

Selbst Städte sind jeweils eine Kopie der anderen, nur mit gedrehten Elementen, gibt ein schönes Video dazu.  Man grindet stundenlang und läuft mehr als das man kämpft. Klar kann man Portale nutzen, aber die kosten ein Vermögen an Azoth wenn man schwer beladen ist und das Zielgebiet nicht der eigenen Fraktion gehört. Man kann danach natürlich auch wieder Azot grinden um sein Konto zu füllen, juhu macht das Spaß.  Das Spiel besteht aus grind grind und nochmal grind und für was, ja genau das ist die gute Frage. Endgame Level 60 Instanzen? Ne ne, braucht man nen Key um reinzukommen und den bekommt man wie, richtig, Mats dafür grinden.  Wenn man nun denkt man bekommt in diesen Dungeon gutes Gear, tja weit gefehlt. Denn dazu muss man erstmal seinen Loot watermark auf ein gewisses Niveau heben. D.h. man bekommt mit Level 60 erstmal nur lauter crap Gear von Truhen und Bossen, mit jedem Item das man lootet erhöht sich dieser Wert.  Man farmt also vorher Tage/Wochenlang irgendwelche Level 60 Elite Gebiete um das watermark System zu befriedigen und kann dann mal einen Dungeon besuchen, ob dann dabei was sinnvolles rauskommt entscheidet alleine der rng Gott.  Hab in meiner gesamten Spielzeit nie ein Spiel gesehen das so sinnlosen grind in einer echt schönen Welt unterbringt. Der Versuch von AGS war gut, aber das Spiel ist es einfach nicht wert noch mehr Stunden darin zu versenken. Da ist mir meine Lebenszeit einfach zu Schade.  Menschen ohne Leben werden hier aber sicherlich eine Beschäftigung für eine lange Zeit finden, habt Spaß!

I would tentatively recommend this game.  As a big Witcher fan, having spent hundreds of hours between all three games, with numerous playthroughs in each, as well as Thronebreaker (and having all the books and comics), I couldn't not give the multiplayer gwent a go.  It advertises itself as free to play, which is awesome, however, to really even get to a place where you can properly enjoy the game, you really do need to invest in at least the journeys that they put out. whilst these aren't too pricey, the do add up, and once you've invested, it's kinda hard to put it down. The element to the game which really frustrates me is that all the rewards are time-limited, so if you bought in a little too late through a journey, you're probably not going to get your money's worth for it as there won't be enough time to earn all of it's rewards. For me, I find this quite annoying, as the first Journey I purchased the extended pass for was Ciri's Journeywhen I first started playing. I had nearly nearly completed all of the objectives, but due to time constraints, not quite, and now they're no longer live, there is no way for me to get some of those rewards. I find this VERY frustrating, as my hope for this game was that it would not be such a time intensive game, but rather something that I could just sit back and play from time to time. If you're not bothered about any rewards, then  fair enough, but for me, when I pay for something, I like to get every last penny's worth... That being said, the Journeys are pretty fun, add some nice story and a whole host of battlepass-esque rewards.  The game in and of itself, is pretty great. Ignoring all the issues about paying for it and missing out on certain rewards if you weren't there on time or didn't have the right amount of time to invest in the game for a few weeks, the game is great. It's a good bit of fun, with a huge range of decks that you can build from the enormous range of cards they have, which they update on a regular basis. Moreover, every month they have a new season, which brings with it a new seasonal play style, which means you get to play different rule sets, which also helps to keep the game fresh. So amongst the constantly changing meta and periodically changing seasonal rules, there is a lot of fun that can be had with this game, if you like this sorta thing. With real opponents, it really helps bring the game to life, as you're always facing some different deck or playstyle, which provides plenty of challenge.  Be prepared though, if you played Witcher 3, this version of gwent is significantly different. I would recommend trying out Thronebreaker first, if you're unsure about investing yourself in Gwent.

[code]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家【[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/10566883]中国玩家鉴赏组[/url]】  加入我们的小组吧【[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/875486]点这里[/url]】[/code]  《满庭芳：宋上繁华》是一款带有古风古韵的城市建造类游戏，游戏尽可能的还原了宋朝建筑、行业、职业和服饰，以独特的手绘国风元素，让玩家成为了建造城市的画手，从规划道路良田到让百姓丰衣足食逐步建设管理自己的城市，最终描绘出属于自己的“清明上河图”。  虽然不知道这类游戏的画风有什么专有名词，但是无论是《江南百景图》还是《桃园深处有人家》等游戏，画面一看上去就让人觉得清新舒适，各种建筑、环境的细节动态展示让这副涵盖整个城池的画卷有了不少烟火气，女子路边绣花、百姓小摊徘徊、林中男女交儿、市井垂髫穿梭，生活百态都一一展现。  《满庭芳：宋上繁华》以模拟经营和资源管理为核心玩法，你得为“刁民”们建造栖身之所，在冬季来临之前囤积粮草，进行务农百工，收集木材石材等资源，同时注意灾害疫病，市井游客，抵御外族入侵，提供科举人才等等的规划和管理。人口多了，需求也就增加，满足不了需求就会累计民怨，可能会进一步发展为覆舟的结局；但城市的发展也需要人口，建设也需要税收，所以如何让不断增长的人口和经济发展速度相匹配，是玩家思考的重点。  游戏在传统模拟经营的玩法基础上，也贴近时代背景做了一些改进，比如在书院里除了可以升级各种建筑和实施新法令之外，还可以培养士子每年参加科举，及第的人也会成为玩家幕僚团队的一员。其他如隐藏的建筑搭配获取收益加成，符合宋朝时代背景的城池防御玩法等等也都是制作组求变的出路。  《满庭芳：宋上繁华》目前在新手引导上做的不够清晰，不够严谨的数值逻辑，备受争议的谣言系统都有些拖后腿，但是美术和整体框架确实也加分不少，喜欢这种类型的玩家可以考虑入手。

简要概括一下，三种兵种。 1长矛手 主力输出，攻击非常猛，在高坡作战非常有利（“尖锐武器”给长矛手效果不错，感谢雨帆dalao指正） 技能是持枪冲锋，非常好用建议马上就升级来用，高爆发和位移集一体。 缺点非常怕被冲锋，非常怕飞刀和弓箭，不适合空旷作战，被冲散只能挨打，吃地形。 前中期主力。  2弓箭手 副输出，前期没啥用（想用就赶紧升级），主要是中后期没这货不行，三个原因。 首先是前期弓箭射箭完全射不到几下，射击精度还不如泼水呢，升级起来才好用。 其次是敌方双刀兵会无脑跳跃到咱脸上砍，什么兵都扛不住，主要靠弓箭克制它，优先远程点掉。 还有后期敌方披甲士兵和小杂兵众多，据险力守也就清掉披甲兵，低处的小杂兵还是得靠弓箭应对. 后期输出主力。  3盾牌手 坦克，辅助，万金油兵种，技能下落攻击在某些地形高的地方跳下去还不错 只要是恢复性的角色特性，都和盾兵比较适配，比如快速补给之类的 主要放在敌方远程火力最大的位置上抗压，也可以配合长矛手前后变换阵型（毕竟长矛移动中不能攻击） 后期应对敌人披甲飞刀兵，大弓，对付冲过来的双刀兵非常重要（没盾兵的话双刀兵冲过来你的长矛必死光）  -还有啊，每个房子都是可以进去补血的！好多人不知道，那玩意不只是产钱建筑。  关于物品嘛，有啥用啥，咱又不能选，目前就觉得地雷最好使，指挥戒指给弓箭最好

This game appeals to a lot of categories - [i]fans of simulation games, fans of Sweeney Todd and Goths™ in general.[/i]  It's incredibly accessible, being able to be played entirely with just a mouse (scroll wheel and clicking, that's all you need!) and without a huge fuss over having to use a lot of buttons.   Visually, the game is great, with a special attention to detail on the gory details when you 'prepare the meat' which I absolutely adored. The drawn cut scene sections are gorgeous, and the simplistic UI makes it very easy to understand what everything is and what you're doing. Personally I appreciated how simple the recipe book was, making it easy to reference, and also including recipe ingredients with table-orders too.  The story follows a very similar vein to Sweeney Todd but puts it's own spin on the general idea, and I think it does a great job with that. The voice acting is lovely, and it's got a lot of Todd references thrown in as well as a few references to other things (Big fan of the plant in the garden ;D)  Game play wise it's simple to learn, with enough upgrades and unlockables to keep it interesting for the whole run -  you can entirely unlock [b]everything[/b] including skins within a single playthrough, which is great considering it's just a single story.  That's another key feature I actually love, it's quite short! You don't have to slog for ages to unlock things and you're not left feeling like you're missing out on anything. For [u]£3.99[/u], it's absolutely a perfect length of a game for an enjoyable, accessible story with a lot of charm and fun along the way. I finished it after a couple of days of casual play, and considering how cheap it is, I really felt like it was worth even more than that for the sheer amount of enjoyment it gave me.  Also a [b]massive[/b] cheer for unlockable outfits! There's a number of outfits you can unlock with the money you make in the shops, and you are entirely able to get them all in a single run - I had a lot of fun switching around them per shift especially with the very last spooky ones.  Honestly, if you're looking for something lighthearted, gothic and charming, that's simple to learn and won't take you too long to get through, I recommend this. And for those who love a little achievement hunt - you can easily get all achievements within a single run too.

Mesmo estando em acesso antecipado, o jogo conta com várias missões que, infelizmente, estão em inglês, mas mesmo assim não deixam de ser muito boas e divertidas. O jogo conta com um sistema divertido entre amanhecer, meio dia, entardecer e noite, onde possivelmente haverá missões que terão de ser executadas em horários específicos e lugares onde só será possível descobrir num momento específico do dia. Os gráficos lembram bastante jogos antigos e até atuais como os jogos da Puppet Combo. Em Dread Delusion, há como você criar poções, melhorar armas e há magias que, até agora, parecem ser poucas (espero que adicionem mais futuramente kkkkkk), enfim, é um jogo que merece atenção e seu dinheiro com certeza, sem falar que Dread Delusion é um jogo que pode parecer até que psicodélico, mas uma coisa que amo nele é como os NPCs agem como se tudo fosse normal e já estivessem acostumados com aquilo tudo, assim como nós, que estamos acostumados com a nossa vida cotidiana, e essa mistura em saber que nada daquilo é normal mas ao mesmo tempo tudo é normal no jogo deixa o game mais intrigante e divertido, e há nele passagens secretas, uma boa música de fundo que não te faz enjoar ou se sentir desconfortável.

It is a decent game. In its current state I would recommend it after another year in the oven.   Unfortunately the core part of the game is a brain dead experience. There's very little about it that is very fun or engaging. You have all killed 10 wolves and collected 5 of whatever in many games before. Guess what you get to do it here but arguably more boring and dull than any game you have done it in. The glamor of the combat wears off pretty quickly into the leveling process. Once you get to the mid 40s it is an absolute slog to get to the end. Once you get to the end you get to grind out your gear score. Surprisingly this is even LESS of an enjoyable experience compared to the rest of the game. You don't do anything new or special for your late game gear. You either craft, quest, or RNG drop your final gear. Remarkable. Wars are an absolute joke to be frank. Yeah the grand strategy portion of it, the organizing of 50 players, etc all of that is real slick. Actually playing in a war though? In its current state its barely playable. Exploits left and right. Tooltips on your skills inaccurate. Can't tell who is who or what's doing what. It's for lack of a better way to put it- a shit show.  So what *is* good about this game? It's not so much the game as I stated above. However to not give the game any credit at all would be wrong. It's the players. The world we control. The politics. The fact that the server count is restricted to 2000 players or less. Your name has a reputation much like your company and your faction. The fun that you get from the proximity chat, running a company, and indulging in your servers political drama is the only leg this game is standing on. It's unrivaled and really can barely be compared to anything modernly available. They did a really good job on the world design and creating incentive or forcing PvP situations. Also, there is an endgame instanced PvP mode called Outpost Rush. It is very fun and is imo the only thing enjoyable to do once you hit 60.   Imo the game is showing its flaws from its development shift. It seems to me a lot of the deeper issues with the game that I don't really point out here are from the devs reworking the game from its original design philosophy to its current one. I'm sure this will get addressed as time goes on.  Tldr- Game is overflowing with potential but at its core it is a dull and boring game with an overwhelming amount of serious bugs.. Check it out next year.

My second playthrough was long range spells and archer focused, which I feel is not polished enough. The spells are good and I can't wait for more schools of magic but the archery need work. I just shoot I can't really aim,I click, it pulls and shoot. I feel the need to aim before clicking which isn't enjoyable when I want to feel immersed. I also think a crossbow would be a good addition with a longer reload time but A lot more heavy hitting, also please make head shots deal 25% of full health damage as I felt weak when I shot a guy in the face and it only took 6% of his health.   Now the base building. I can say the base building was functional but not impressive, in fact I feel like I enjoyed the demo way of building more than the prologue when I was building in first person I felt scale while in this version it felt underwhelming. I also feel you should be able to demolish all building except your main and being able to edit the layout if you want. The upgrade system for the forge and a few building need to be fleshed out like mabey making level 1 forge making the common tool and level 3 the uncommon as well as making the previous ranks tools just a bit cheaper to make. Also a few animation like your minions standing guard,some coming back with bags of resources with axes or picks in hand would make it look better and lastly have idle animation play, like having a skeleton brawl with another skeleton or having a human minion grab the leg of a skeleton and run of while the skeleton chases. Of course I know these sound silly but idle animation are important to bringing live to a base  The base management was okay and it didn't feel clunky, however making seberate tables for Idle, Gathering and following would make it cleaner to work with. The expeditions were a good idea but making them get you crafting materials and or rare building materials you can't just get your minions to gather would make them more functional and useful in the larger scheme of things than having them gather common building materials and 1 useful item. Also making them run in the back ground would be better than a short 30 second wait you have to almost constantly check on, make them 5 or so minutes and have them tell the player in a clear way.  Minions, there are a few problems like when I gave my skeletons a bow it went in and fought with fist, making skeletons shoot make sense, make it that skeletons can shoot arrow and fight but cant use magic or having worse stats or something if you want to entice players to make humans minions rather than skeleton ones. I also feel that 4 minion are little, making 5 to possibly 10 would make the actual battles a lot funner as having a mage shoot magic 2 archers and 7 guys fighting would look and feel better than just 4 guys doing it all as All rounded combat masters when they chose they want to do what they want, mabey classifying them as a mage, skirmisher and melee would make it that they focus on doing that and changing when it is needed like a archer being attacked pulls out his secondary to fight in melee. Also I cant wait for the mutations as I want to see how that will work in making truly hideous monsters. Also a possible change is to make it that only people who were magic user could be mages if brought back to live.  Now for bugs and tweaks I feel are needed, make the bosses a bit harder as I beat the first boss in like 10 seconds. That not an over exageration it was easy, when I spawn with my undead at the gravestone my loot was all gone, like all gone it took me a few restarts when I decided to exchange my gear with a random minion, go into spirit form, spawn and then quickly exchange back. It was annoying but manageable, also please make the big units like the trolls fight back when he is attacked, sure it 1 hit kills but just so that it's not completely defensless.  Now the dialogue and cutscenes can use a bit of work but it isn't as important as the other thing I have mentioned before, its good enough but improvements are always possible  This is my full opinion, a good game thus far but need tweaks, fixes and improvements in certain areas to make it truly reach its fullest potential. The game is probably gone be well tweaked and improved but these were all the things I saw as the biggest or personal issues I saw from the game

这真的是一款非常好玩的游戏，虽然我经常打不过，但不妨碍我体验其中的乐趣。键盘默认的键位确实不太好按，但是苟住有耐心的话……还是能玩的比较开心。 （1）深度丰富的游戏系统 这个大家都分析的挺到位了，本来我觉得有天平业称系统，元素成长系统，武器铠甲精通系统已经很厉害了……玩的也很不亦乐乎了。没想到新章节居然还增加了新的成长系统，把我吓得目瞪口呆……这工作量和深度，这不得让玩家刷晕在里面啊，我可懒得刷…… （2）跌宕起伏的游戏剧情 这是这个游戏最棒的部分。序章的村子沧海桑田一下就把我抓住了。泊灵的故事荡气回肠，让人扼腕。嘉隆的身份一直让我揪心，没想到最后回看封面的角色们，真的都是命运。 命运的捉弄与反抗，是个非常古典而又经典的主题，故事讲得前后勾连，配角人物们各有各的精彩人生，实在是令我非常满意。能玩到这么个好故事的确是不虚此行的。 （3）味儿太正宗了 看到有好友批评里面的女性角色塑造，我感觉其实大可不必这么上纲上线说它媚男媚宅……它就是一款千禧年的梦，在那之前80年代的动画里还有幸运色狼这种角色呢。那时候的角色塑造确实会有物化女性的问题，但真没必要这么骂，毕竟瑕不掩瑜。你指望一个十四年来都在花自己所有的业余时间做游戏的阿宅对女人能有多么深刻的创见吗……那肯定都是从书本和动画里学习关于女性的知识啦！至少目前来说，这里面的日系老掉牙瑟瑟剧情（什么巨乳扇脸啦，百合猛舔啦，猛男大战M字腿，温泉偷看啦……）这些都绝不是首创，完全是宅男的恶趣味和老动画的结合，一笑了之就好。实际上整个故事对女性角色的塑造已经相当有血有肉，即使是脸谱，那也是经典的脸谱。每位女性角色都有自己的动机和生活，还要啥自行车啊。（真要骂我觉得还不如骂骂现实中的性别不平等，阿宅何必为难阿宅啊） 经典，经典才是常读常新的。

From my time playing the October beta and the Pre-launch beta i can say i'm really excited to see where the game goes from launch! I really enjoyed the Vermintide games, so i was expecting big things to come from Darktide and i'm not disappointed. Graphics are beautifully grim with performance having improved greatly, gameplay is extremely fun, from slashing through hordes of poxwalkers to sticking your axe into the back of a plagued ogryn.   The introduction was what caught me off guard, it took its time for presumably easy and smooth controls and the cinematics involving the escape from the cell didnt feel very warhammer. I felt VERY insulted when the corrupted guardsmen wouldnt take me to nurgles loving arms, instead leaving me there to be fed to the poxwalkers. The rest of the cinematics however where great, seeing a valkyrie fly on from below as your being chased to your evac is amazing.  Something that does concern me is the variety of firearms and melee weapons, especially for the sharpshooter. When i hit level 12 i was hoping for a plasma gun or something equivalent but i was stuck with autoguns, pistols and lasguns, which are amazing as the weapons feel so fluid and fun to use. Maybe i will see something new soon.  Overrall i tried my best not sucking up to the game when first playing it, but i feel as if i never would have needed to, as i can express my opinion that the game in its current PRE-LAUNCH STATE is fun. 这是一款完美的第一人称恐怖射击游戏。第一人称是我的视角，射击是我的战斗方式，恐怖就是我。 这游戏就是一句话——凭他妈的毁灭战士一人——打倒他妈的全地狱！ 我没玩过前作，一开始还玩的提心吊胆的，因为这种程度的血腥确实有点难以适应。但——一当你适应了，你的杀心就会狂增！劲增！暴增！超过玩其他射击游戏一百倍！霸霸霸霸霸！如此强人，还有什么恶魔能阻挡？还有他妈的什么恶魔能阻挡了？！ 正经来说，这就是一款杀杀杀游戏，没有太多剧情，没有太多思考，就是从一个地方杀到另一个地方。从那些细节方面来说，其实可以看出有挺大的世界观，但游戏里并没有体现出来太多，这部分内容可以体现在在下一作里面的永恒里面。 相比较永恒，我觉得这一代能够带来更多的代入感。从细节提现出来的，最能表现出来的就是在UI和获取资料方面。在永恒里面资料的显示方式是一个浮空的红色书页，而在这一代中则是一座石碑，触摸还有幻像——我觉得这样是更有沉浸感的。 如果你让我从总体上来做选择，我无疑是更中意本作，因为沉浸感不让人觉得容易疲惫，能够让我更长时间的享受着这个游戏。
只能说是神作了。

Tower unite（塔楼联机）由gmod社区独立出来的游戏，该游戏已经有13年的历史。到现在制作组依然在半测试阶段（官方有意在2023-2024年完成测试）但已经达到可游玩的状况。不要被英文和冷服所担忧，小游戏和内容基本不用你翻译都会理解。   1.亚洲服务器设立点在日本和新加坡，一般日本人都在亚服。开了加速器或者梯子，在欧美服可以保证130ping左右延迟。作为经常游迹美服和欧服的玩家，我很少见到歧视言论。没必要把自己搞的太敏感跟傻子一样，谁没事歧视你啊？   2.老外一般喜欢去打玩mini golf（高尔夫）和赌场老虎机。此外这款游戏在土耳其非常火。   3. 官方依旧在更新，不用被冷服这一说法被大大影响（如果你喜欢养老类游戏）。游戏支持创意工坊且游戏内容可以用来装扮你的皮肤、住宿或公寓。   4.游戏内容包括酒吧 赌场 游戏厅 小游戏 钓鱼 官方定时活动等等这类自由类养老式玩法确实在游戏界是独树一帜。   5.此外，官方也在发电发热。近年来官方的资金大都是玩家捐助的，所以该游戏在中国依旧没有史低。所以49块钱就当我个人支持了。（别问为什么，这游戏我蹲史低价蹲了三年。再也没有出现史低情况）   6.Tower unite也可以玩成聊天游戏，在大厅和大家一起聊天（一般在欧美）   7.基本上每个点都有玩家的只不过亚洲玩家少，国外玩家流量主要在中国时间下午或是晚上11点以后。（有争议，但这是我连续玩了三周认识的）   以上是个人一点意见，欢迎讨论。    ——来自小黑盒用户Fujita的评价

前两年还是可以的，说明是有实力做好这个游戏的，但第三年尤其是后半段收尾还是太仓促，很多故事没有讲清楚。 阁主和段师父的路线实在难以让人认同，两人都没有什么亮点体现出来，所以同学强行分阵营也就显得不合理，毕竟主角会犹豫路线选择，同学们肯定也是会犹豫，两位师父现在的剧情里，所体现出来的理念，都不足以让人认同，个人觉得还是需要补充一些二人的闪光点，尤其是段师父，不需要刻意塑造偏执的形象，他主张杀人也不过是不想冒过多风险，段也可以放过阿凌，前面剧情其实也可以铺垫一些，把两人形象塑造的都更立体一点。而木师父的线太过于仓促，且没有结局，应该是没做完吧。 第三年整个氛围太过沉重，还是需要一定的欢乐气氛的。巧后，冥宫的覆灭剧情上都过于简单了，没有很大成就感。恋人只能选一个从剧情上来讲是合理的，个人可以接受，但除了结局图和七夕之外似乎没有额外的特殊对话互动之类的？希望可以补充，没量可以但质要保证啊。 可能是没有大地图模式的缘故，第三年明显时间非常仓促，要收尾的地方太多，加上传书、补四维、性格，因此很多人物和故事都没有讲完整，如果不做大地图的话，城镇模式可能需要好好利用了，这样可以多塞点剧情，不然就只能把年份拉长。 总体上游戏还是可以的，故事整个框架和背景都还可以，大部分人物形象前面塑造的也都不错。不过明显可见游戏并没有最终完成 ，还有不少可以改进的地方，希望后面可以补充完整，虽然现在的楚和段我都不太认同，但我还是愿意相信河洛的。不过对于其他玩家来说，还是建议等游戏真正完结之后再考虑吧。

20年买的，鸽到现在才通关，顺便打了个全成就。 游戏的美术风格和场景的氛围确实牛，天花板级别。时不时就有类似奇异博士的顶级视觉效果，再加上场景各种谜之变化，视觉冲击真的令人过目不忘。 战斗体验中上，第三人称射击＋各种超能力，有多重风格不同的枪械，尽管是第三人称视角，瞄准转态下枪械的动效做的特别帅。但是战斗体验实际上一般，游戏前中期投掷技能特别强，枪械在有强力模组前很刮痧，建议先升投掷技能。而且有些枪械说实话没啥用，看着好看，全程玩下来没用过几次，基本摆设。 游戏剧情和叙事手法可以说是顶级谜语，谜语人中的谜语人，很少见到全程主角云里雾里 叙事虚实结合 各种镜头完全看不懂的游戏了，只能说不好评价（我没看懂），建议看b站视频解析。但是很多scp的设定或者世界观塑造的很不错，尤其是某些异化物的支线，关卡设计水平相当高，喜欢scp的建议把净化异化物支线都做做。 接下来要批评游戏最差的部分了，任务指引和地图设计。这方面真的纯纯的nt，地图普遍有很多层，有的捷径或者通道也是之后才能开的，但是只给你一个平面地图，没有任何标识。很多地方看似能过去实际上过不去，看似是该从这里过去实际上要从另一个地方去，再加上任务指引的不明确，很多时候知道要干嘛但是不知道该怎么去，到了地方又不知道该怎么触发，玩的人脑溢血。更顶级的是游戏的某些收集类支线的设计，真的纯纯司马，什么找霉菌找霉菌宿主找植物，有些阴间地方那是人能找到的吗，我真想一拳打在任务设计师脸上。所以我建议非白金党千万别办那种让你找东西的任务，要办的话也速速去搜攻略，自己找有的真要找一小时。 总结一下是很优秀的作品，瑕不掩瑜。喜欢scp以及喜欢视觉上炫技的玩家推荐购买，但是非白金党千万别做寻找收集类支线任务（再次提醒）。

本作中规中矩吧，没有特别大的硬伤，整体体验属中上乘，但相比2代重制版就逊色不少：没有额外模式，砍了原版很多内容（比如多结局设定和佣兵模式），流程比较短，我这种收集癖文件全看加上不跳剧情通关时长才只有10小时，不像RE2那样表里关+额外模式可以一遍又一遍的玩，但考虑到原版剧情流程就不长，重制版这方面也算是致敬经典了（乐）。画面和优化都非常好，低配置玩家的福音；中文配音也很不错，几乎没有棒读意味，可以放心用简中文本+配音游玩。  4代重制版也要正式发售了，前段时间已预购标准版。我虽不是资深生化老粉，接触游戏的时间也很短，但也是从小看着真人和CG电影长大的，深深痴迷于世界观和人物剧情设定，也一直喜欢生化到现在，看着里昂 克莱尔 吉尔 瑞贝卡 艾达 威斯克等等一众经典元老级人物或纷纷退场离去，或默默隐于幕后，心里感慨万千，很是不舍，但同时我也很高兴看到卡婊能积极求变，不管是新增主角伊森一家还是大胆应用第一人称主视角，亦或者是稳步开发重制版，这些都为生化这样一个延续了26年的老牌IP注入了新鲜血液，重焕生机活力，更是发扬和传承了系列游戏一直以来的高水准高评价，这些对于一个高龄IP来说是求之不得、难能可贵的，殊不知有多少老IP因为种种原因而落寞和沉寂，更有甚者被雪藏或直接腰斩，生化能有今天这种热度和发展势头我自然是由衷感到高兴的。  值此4代重制版发售前夕，想说的话，想感慨的事很多，以上三言两语实属肺腑之词，卡婊没有愧对玩家，也没有愧对这个IP，而我作为一个热爱生化的普通玩家，所能做的就是尽力支持，希望生化越来越好，希望我所爱的万事万物都能永远年轻，永远生机焕发。

Si rare d'avoir un roguelite tour par tour qui n'est pas un jeu de cartes. Très chill avec une belle direction artistique, graphismes agréables, et plutôt sympa à jouer mais avec deux problèmes majeurs : - Trop peu de diversité, une fois fini (20h de gameplay) les runs sont toutes les mêmes, level design identique, trop peu de synergies/sorts/armes/boss c'est dommage, le jeu aurait été parfait avec une bonne rejouabilité, l'aspect roguelite est presque usurpé. - Les armes sont trop inégales, la hache étant top tier en se déplaçant correctement puisqu'on peut balayer autour de soi et donc toucher les ennemis en diagonale sans qu'ils ne puissent rien faire, alors que le build dagues est difficilement viable en comparaison par exemple avec un moveset basique et une faible portée.  Mélange de genres assez unique et malheureusement bien trop rare, j'en voudrais plus dans ce style, le côté chill et posé est vraiment agréable, avec la possibilité d'accentuer la difficulté avec les malédictions par exemple, et quelques améliorations post-runs sympathiques mais on les a vite toutes débloquées. Gros potentiel mais peu exploité et il n'y a plus d'ajouts de contenu. Un jeu avec toutes ces qualités combinées à une grande rejouablilité/diversité aurait été incroyable et m'aurait poussé à revenir régulièrement dessus, comme un Binding of Isaac.

剛玩完Impostor Factory，重溫一下To The Moon，真心覺得這個系列做的很棒！  【遊戲世界觀】 在遊戲故事中，西格蒙德公司（Sigmund）擁有人工編造與修改記憶的技術，並且以此來幫助客戶實現願望，不留遺憾地走完一生。不過，由於記憶被改動後會與大腦的真實認知產生衝突，因此只能在臨終的病人身上使用。  玩家扮演來自西格蒙德公司的一對工作搭檔，一位是個性冷靜的Eva Rosalene（伊娃·羅莎莉恩），另一位是有點中二病，但技術一流的Neil Watts（尼爾·華茲）。他們倆人在工作中常常互相鬥嘴，吐槽對方。幽默搞笑的對白細節，也是遊戲敘事中的一大特色呢。  他們的工作內容是利用公司研發的「記憶機器」去讀取客戶的記憶，並且在機器裡製造出樣本，然後在這個被複製出來記憶世界中，尋找客戶的願望以及產生願望的動機。簡單來說，就是盡可能地進入最早的記憶，逐步跳回客戶的上一個人生階段，從老年、中老年、壯年、青壯年、少年，到童年，在每個階段之間穿梭，還要尋找「記憶碎片」，也就是能夠連結每個階段的關鍵性物品，最後組成一張記憶連結地圖，將願望從童年一路貫穿到老年時期，就能創造出一個實現夢想的完美人生。  由於機器不能隨心所欲更改記憶，必須符合一定的現實邏輯；也不能像寫小說或畫壁畫一樣，憑空幫客戶創造出一個新記憶。夢想之所以能夠實現，主要還是依靠客戶本人的意志驅使，所以弄清楚產生願望的「動機」非常重要。最後，將動機傳送到客戶的童年時期，由客戶自己的意志去創造出新的「完美人生」，而機器只是提供一個演算程式，再把演算結果傳輸到客戶的大腦裡，覆蓋掉以前的記憶，客戶就會相信這些都是真實的。最後帶著願望實現的幸福感劃下人生句點。這就是西格蒙德公司帶給客戶的服務體驗。  【遊戲特色】： 遊戲玩法很簡單，除了觀賞劇情之外，就是尋找「記憶碎片」，在場景裡到處搜索、點擊物品，或進行對話，找齊記憶碎片後，組成記憶鍵接，此時會進入到一個小遊戲介面，完成記憶激活後，就可以進行記憶跳躍，繼續觀賞劇情。本作只有單一結局，任何對話選擇都不會影響結果，偶爾會出現讓玩家選擇由誰行動，不影響劇情走向。同一件事情，Eva和Neil的反應卻不一樣，讓我覺得很有趣！

[h1]一款做的好但不完全好的经营类游戏[/h1] [b]制作[/b] [i]优化[/i] 单项满分十分我愿给本作6.5分。从宣传PV看建筑和人物的建模尚可，但是进入游戏后首先遇到的问题是优化较差，卡顿问题明显，甚至表现在刚进去游戏时右下角的两只鸟的动画都被卡住，动弹不得。作为一个体量不大的卡通风格游戏来说这种表现是不应该的，更吃配置的巫师3与GTAV在我的电脑上运行表现都好于本作。同时在一些场景的加载阶段也无法避免此种情况，甚至是每天必会经历的从家门口出去的场景，不说百分百卡顿起码也是百分之七八十。倘若是遇到隔天早晨自动刷出的剧情，那必会卡至少一分钟。 [i]建模[/i] 这部分稍好，7/10。优点其实一目了然——每个人物都有独具特色的人物建模，在建筑的风格特色上也颇具匠心。至于人物说话嘴从来不动、脸上永远没有表情、角色CV配音完全出戏等问题，我愿归结为工作室体量小、技术力尚不能满足需求。对一个装修迷来说家具数量和自定义程度其实尚不能满足我，在AG建筑公司的“家园装修”条目中其实可供选择的类别非常少，以及我在大后期给房子换了个造型，占地的格子都大了好多好多，结果进入房价之后发现内饰和房型结构没有任何变化。。。。。。作为一栋别墅，一楼尾侧那么大一块空地竟然不能加装任何物品，属实是匪夷所思啊。 [b]剧情[/b] 7/10吧。对本人而言剧情在经营游戏中的优先级并非排行第一，因此不会过于关注本项——对，满脑子想着肝就完了。就最后“父亲的归来”这一小节来说纯粹是匪夷所思，以至于我每个对话选项必选骂他的。。。当爹的自己跑路把小孩扔外边不管，该不会是尼之血统觉醒吧。和明特结婚的时候我话还没说完他就跑路了，捏马害怕我吃人是吧。触发一个剧情之后怎么活都安排给我了呀恼怒，你们出去休闲娱乐我再给老爷们下地干活是吧。 [b]总结[/b] 值回票价吧，当时买了三十来块好像，玩了也七八十个小时了，还是挺不错的。要求不能太高，况且已经在现有的水平下拿出了不错的游戏性，差强人意吧，毕竟要有耐心^ ^

游戏优化不错了,但是居然出现了因为移植导致的无论如何都会出现的贴图错误,远处的树木草丛贴图总是出现乱码,而且和驱动无关,这个情况之能通过降低显存来缓解,记住不是解决是缓解  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  首先这代游戏不错，但是4代实在是太优秀了 首先先说下我的测评配置：  我是高中学生党平时不怎么用台式，外星人X17的笔记本3080满血8G，32G双通道运行内存，11代i7，评测内容为画质全极端无脑拉最高，画质2k屏幕，游戏时是插电开的高风扇游戏模式，没有使用Nvdia Experience（谁用这负优化），显卡驱动496.49  说实话和四代有很大的光影和画质的进步，车辆黑暗地区的灯光反射还有车表面的光影反射非常到位，相比四代无画面补丁的情况下进步非常大，而且仅凭游戏的抗锯齿不依靠N卡设置也没有任何狗牙和不柔和的地方，即便是2k画质都相当真实，在墨西哥的山城背景下感觉一切都可以以假乱真，车辆的入水水珠效果也处理很好，并且新的遗迹探索玩法也很让人能引入墨西哥的文化气息，但新的沙尘暴天气系统个人觉得可有可无（说白了里面的沙城暴除了进去像个黄色的滤镜有什么细节反馈吗？隔壁战地2042虽然现在看起来不咋地但别人开车进沙尘暴好歹物理反馈比如沙子敲打车窗汽车行驶受影响很真实啊！），除了这些还有各种奇怪的bug，虽然目前大多数反映的bug比如闪退我并没有遇到但是可见问题不小，优化也有些问题，到很多地方会莫名其妙卡顿，特别是从嘉年华出来时会有明显剧烈掉帧情况，估计是在即时贴图加载（这点学学四代！）游戏帧数一直都在110帧左右但是很多地方因为优化问题或者加载问题会瞬间掉帧到85甚至60帧造成卡顿，总之目前来说我对游戏的评价是个好游戏，但前提是给没玩4代的游戏玩家，对于没有玩过4代的玩家这代是入坑地平线系列感受真实驾驶的良作，但对于系列玩家来说，这代的内容让我失望，4代的那种在薰衣草田园旁驱车漫步的感觉和轻松的bgm所带来的放松感是任何其他游戏所很难带给我的，如果只是加入了墨西哥地图画质提升和“黄色飞沙滤镜”的这部作品，那我更愿意想之为地平线4plus，基本没有什么相比前代的新东西但是分量管饱，但如果是为了画质去玩那甚至我会建议身边玩家去玩打了高清画质光影补丁的地平线4，这代游戏不错，但是4代实在是太优秀了，这代玩起来让我一直会以为是加了墨西哥dlc和高清画质补丁的地平线4，游戏才刚发布开始没多久，等到半年后我再看看优化做的怎么样我再收回我的差评。

！！真 ！！实 ！！评 ！！测 ！！玩前必看 ！！ 作为我玩的第一款国产电影走向式游戏，从热点题材进行改编，真的非常惊艳到我。这篇评论将从四个方面进行评价本作，10分为满分，故事性、可玩性、画面感、操作感。 第一，故事性，10分：作为热点题材进行改编的故事情节，全程紧凑但不失条理，无论是每个小故事还是自我探索的小片段都贴合主线并引人入胜，并无拖沓拉长，时不时的穿插也非常点睛，让我看到了该类别国产游戏的一个崛起。 第二，可玩性，8分；从目前感恩篇来说，存在许多不同的选择和不同的故事路线，但是总体的主线并无太大变化，不同选择带来的小改变确实会吸引人一会但也会令人疲倦，该游戏并没有设置许多不同的选择像底特律变人一样，这令我十分惊讶，因为这避免了多次重复的疲倦感，但又不失其带来的小新鲜感，很不错，至少很对得起这个价位的设置，很良心，整个游戏主要还是一次性体验主线。 第三，画面感，8分；作为电影走向式的游戏，从电影画面来说，无论是演员的演技、场景的布置亦或是整体的质感，都十分真实且贴合题材，十分抓人眼球，但是从每个片段的衔接来看，确实后期团队的制作并没有底特律变人那么流畅自然，当然底特律变人的团队制作技术无法比较，所以还是对本作十分的满意。 第四，操作感，6分；整个感恩篇的操作感会使人从电影的沉浸式体验中脱节，略显得有些突兀，也许是因为使用键鼠游玩的原因，不知道如果能够用手柄体验的话会不会有所改善，操作感确实有许多需要改进的地方。 总体评价目前的感恩篇，9分，从价位上来看十分良心，非常建议入手体验，你会体验到该类别国产游戏的崛起，我相信本作会特别惊艳到你，也十分期待团队接下来带来的DLC反击篇。这也是我如此用心的评价一部作品。十分感谢游戏团队，能够再次提起热点题材，能够精心制作这款游戏，我非常受感动，祝愿你们一切都好并持续为广大玩家带来佳作！ 我作为广大玩家中的一员，真诚的感谢游戏团队，谢谢你们！
