[h1] 总体而言值得一玩[/h1]  作为一款大热IP下的开放世界游戏，我个人能给到8分，对于部分一直向往魔法世界的哈利波特迷来说或许能有9分。游戏内要素算是比较丰富，可以说是蛮精致了。诚然这是一款标准的罐头游戏，经典的清单式开放世界，不过虽有槽点，依然瑕不掩瑜。  [b]先说优点[/b]：本作的画面称不上顶级，不过某些对人物表情动作的细节刻画上可以说是比较用心的，对于魔法世界的塑造以及咒语效果的呈现也可谓是成功的。尤其体现在霍格沃茨场景内：在校园中探索的时候便不难发现各个场景的内容都不会显得空洞，墙上画中的人物视线会随主角而动，走廊里会有盔甲在干架，经常能遇到皮皮鬼在恶作剧（确实欠）——包括但不限于此，在对校园的高度还原中，制作组的用心程度可见一斑。  在主线剧情的设计上大致值得肯定，剧情并不复杂，但穿插了大量较高质量的动画与对话选择，中间也加入了不少延伸出来的支线任务，难度适中（从易到难有四个难度可供选择），对于各类玩家都很友好，且各支线在重复度方面也已经尽可能降低，各种解密也并不会过快地让人感觉无聊。  游戏中也带有装修、养魔法动物、种植与制作魔药等系统，相比较下装修（改造有求必应屋）和养魔法动物这两点设计得更全面一些，可供玩家休闲的可能性是存在的，而对有求必应屋的设计算是能让人眼前一亮。外观系统方面，可以自主选择穿衣的外观，打造各种个性穿搭——对想成为黑巫师的本人十分友好。  本作的战斗系统设计得并不复杂，可以说是挺简单直白了：攻击、防御、生命三种数值，通过升级和装备增加属性；战斗方面普攻、咒语、古代魔法、植物、魔药五种输出方式，可以在一个NPC的支线中学会三种不可饶恕咒，想必对于立志进入阿兹卡班的各位是一个好消息，在魔法世界用不可饶恕咒大杀四方还没人管，爽感是给到了。同时，玩家可以在天赋上自由加点，继续加强战斗能力（增加爽感）。  [b]有待改进之处[/b]：首先还是在战斗系统方面，设计得简单的同时必然存在着缺点，攻击方式就这么几种，战斗的机制也很简单：攻击、防反、闪避，植物和魔药的种类很少，对本人而言这两种东西除了支线任务要求外其余的战斗中一概没用到，甚至是根本没有想起来包里还有这俩玩意儿···咒语总共二十来钟，其实可以更丰富一些，从而给予玩法更多的可能性。战斗之外，咒语除了解密需要特定的几种，便没有更多的作用了，也无法与其余的场景交互。  而关于场景交互的问题，除去上述这方面外（上面这个其实无伤大雅），与NPC的交互并不多，与路人无法产生碰撞，顶多让人物晃一晃，并不能够撞掉路人手中的物件，被撞的人也不会吐槽主角（太老实了哈哈哈哈）。游戏的流程下来会结识各路NPC，许多人物通过三言两语和表情的呈现很快便能塑造出鲜明的人物形象，只是可惜极大部分在任务过后便杳无音讯从此不再往来，并没有能够一直互动的NPC，某种程度上说大家都不过是给任务的工具人。宿舍中除了主角一个舍友都没有，可以说主角完全独行侠（天煞孤星？）。  休闲玩法中，种植和魔药制作可谓是一笔带过，过于简单的系统导致这两个方面基本没有什么玩法，种子一播，魔药配方一选，点一下鼠标就结束了，设计的深入程度远不如在有求必应屋的装修系统上。坐骑方面，本作有陆地坐骑、飞行坐骑和扫帚供玩家选择，尴尬的是，飞行坐骑和扫帚属于高度重复，便利性还不如扫帚，有些鸡肋，而陆地坐骑的存在感更低，基本用不到，然而两种坐骑要说舍弃掉也可惜，造就了一个有些矛盾的局面。  个人来说，本作最为遗憾的一点是在校园玩法上，主角上课就是看了个动画学个咒语便结束了，课堂方面并没有继续延伸，任务做完便上不了课了···很大程度上削减了校园生活的乐趣，后续对上课有关系的是“作业”支线，完成要求后也是看个动画学个咒语便结束，之后主角便再无课程。在游戏流程刚开始的一段，有个学生决斗的玩法，个人感觉蛮有趣味性，只是在打赢了三场后便宣布主角成为了决斗冠军，之后也没有继续下去，本以为是个可以一直存在的玩法，可惜了。  本作中并没有魁地奇的玩法，因为校长个人的原因取消了魁地奇比赛，也算是少了一项特色吧，游戏的大框架构建得很完整，还可以加入很多不同的玩法，本作依然存在很多的可能性。  [b]个人吐槽[/b]：养魔法动物的玩法中，游戏给的说法是拯救魔法动物，实际上就是[spoiler]抓来当宠物薅人家毛[/spoiler]；不可饶恕咒明目张胆地用，天天开人家锁当人面开箱子，[spoiler]有时候会怀疑到底谁是反派[/spoiler]；出于对幻身咒和统统石化的熟练运用，[spoiler]已经玩成了刺客信条：魔法世界[/spoiler]。  综上，是一款优秀的罐头，我乐意吃。  [strike]由衷地希望我在魔法世界的传奇故事可以伴随小汤姆安然入睡。[/strike]

Mesmo sendo bastante assustador e divertido esse jogo não é pra qlqr público, pois ele é super complexo e difícil de entender.. tanto é qe vcê já se perde toda logo no tutorial e mesmo depois de completar ainda precisa de mto treinamento para compreender o qe fzer e como jogar. O objetivo principal é basicamente explorar locais mal-assombrados (como casas e outras construções) em busca de registrar provas de qe há algum fantasma de fato, evitando morrer para o mesmo durante a investigação... e o jogo requer trabalho em equipe constante, preferencialmente com um grupo fechado de quatro pessoas e a comunicação por voz é essencial (pois nem mesmo há chat de texto no jogo), então se não tiver microfone ou quiser jogar single vcê mto provavelmente vai desistir logo de cara, prqê a graça do jogo é justamente conversar cm a equipe o tempo todo, levar sustos jntos e pensar em estratégias de como chamar atenção e se comunicar cm o fantasma, bem como identificar ql tipo de fantasma ele é (demônio, Banshee, witch, entre vários outros), já qe cada um tem suas fraquezas e pontos fortes particulares. Há possibilidade de jogar cm pessoas aleatórias caso vcê queira, e ao abrir uma partida pública geralmente não demora mto pra outras pessoas entrarem e começarem a falar e se enturmar. E apesar de toda complexidade se vcê conseguir entender o básico já dá pra se divertir bastante, pois tem muita coisa legal e diferente qe realmente te faz sentir em uma investigação paranormal cinematográfica: é possível falar com o fantasma usando um comunicador “spirit box”, apenas perguntas básicas como “onde vcê está” ou “qual sua idade” e dependendo do tipo de fantasma ele vai te responder por voz (é possível configurar para ele entender português, mas as respostas são somente em inglês de qlqr forma); em algumas situações é possível se comunicar cm a entidade usando um livro de escrita e até mesmo um ouija (aquele famoso tabuleiro com várias letras e números típicos de filmes de terror); há muitos aparatos interessantes para caçar fantasmas, bem como itens importantes para fazer “rituais” qe espantam o fantasma (como incensos e velas, dependendo sempre das fraquezas do fantasma qe vcê está lidando); é possível fzer várias táticas diferentes para maiores chances, como por exemplo uma pessoa ficar cm a câmera andando pela casa no escuro e outra ficar dentro da cabine de equipamentos acompanhando o qe está sendo filmado em visão noturna por uma tela em busca de aparições; o terror é mto profundo, vcê realmente se sente dentro do jogo e fica nervosa e sob pressão constante, dá muito medo principalmente qndo o fantasma apaga as luzes ou faz a lanterna ficar piscando enqnto vcê ouve passos se aproximando ou grunhidos horripilantes; além de se manifestarem visualmente como sombras ou aparições horrendas a qlqr momento, os fantasmas podem te matar se vcê não tomar cuidado, e ao morrer a pessoa perde o contato com as demais, não consegue mais se comunicar e fica vendo tudo como se tivesse se tornado um fantasma também. Com isso recomendo fortemente esse jogo pra qm ama terror e cooperativo online com bastante comunicação e trabalho em equipe, bem como pra qm sempre quis ter uma experiência única de como seria caçar fantasmas de uma maneira mais realista... esse é sem dúvidas um jogo sem igual, porém vale ressaltar mais uma vez de qe ele não é pra qlqr público, pois ele é extremamente difícil e complicado, vcê não vai aprender a jogar da noite pro dia, e mesmo qndo aprender ainda vai sofrer bastante dependendo da equipe e, é claro, da entidade qe vcê estará lidando.

Joke aside, this game is honestly really enjoyable.   Pros: Chess aspect of the game is still pretty important, although now you have to actually consider your captures. While you could easily capture a pawn with a higher piece, you have to double check, making sure the enemy pawn doesn't blast your Queen's face off with a musket.  Gunplay is surprisingly fun. Each piece has 2 abilities and different weapons, allowing for natural counterplays and new strategies which normal chess can't give you.  It's just.. really damn fun? I haven't had this much fun playing chess in YEARS!  Check/Checkmate no longer exist. Your king can make a valiant last stand with his sword and try to deck the life out of the attacking piece, potentially saving yourself from certain doom!   Cons:  Some of the game is slightly buggy.  - Sometimes, pieces fall through the board and become unplayable despite still being in the game. I had it happen to my king, making me immortal as I couldn't lose the game. Fun for me, not so fun for my opponent. - Rook's grapple hook often fails to work - Rook's wall sometimes flings when built too close to solid map objects - King's jump can be used to go out of bounds and clip through walls  Game uses a lot of GPU. Perhaps a crypto miner, perhaps poorly optimised. Honestly if this game is mining shitcoins with my GPU I'm not too offended because it's still fun asf, but still.  Rook has a sniper rifle with a scope, however the scope sensitivity is atrocious and cannot be changed. You're better off just hipfiring with it and praying.  You get hitmarkers for hitting pieces even if they aren't part of the combat. Not a major issue, but it sometimes throws me off when I'm trying to shoot a player's pawn, hit a non-player pawn and I still get a hitmarker.  Overall, I still recommend this game. Great for a few hours of fun with a friend, although currently too buggy and unoptimised to be worth investing longterm effort into. A few fixes and patches would make this game perfect.

In terms of graphics, the game looks great, the world is not the biggest, but over time the map will expand. Vontade é a palavra que mais marcou nesse jogo, em todos os aspectos que irei mencionar mais para frente.  [/h1]Gameplay[/h1] A gameplay do FarCry 5 é extremamente repetitiva, pelo fato já mencionado a cima da história ser muito curta, resolveram tentar esticar as ''horas de gameplay'' enfiando no jogador um conteudo repetitivo e enjoativo, que se resume em ficar tacando o caos de forma aleatória pelo mapa, destruindo tudo de forma aleatória e assim enchendo uma barra, quando a barra por fim encher o chefão aparece, e isso se repete pelos 3 cantos do mapa, para os 3 chefões que existem, SEMPRE a mesma coisa, repetição atrás de repetição, sem novidade do começo ao fim do jogo. A gameplay se torna cansativa, e não ache você que jogar com um amigo melhora isso em algum aspecto, porque não irá melhorar, eu joguei o jogo inteiro com minha namorada, e mesmo assim tive toda a experiencia mencionada. A dificuldade do jogo é bizarramente facil, MUITO FÁCIL, se resume a você pegar um helicoptero e destruir tudo com ele, matar todos os inimigos e por ai vai, mesmo subindo a dificuldade a facilidade continua. Não existe chefão dificil no jogo, todos são extremamente faceis, simples e não possui necessidade alguma de pensar no que deve ser feito para confronta-los, apenas atire, atire e atire.  Em suma o Far Cry 5 na minha opinião é o pior Far Cry entre todos os outros antecessores, a história é curta, a gameplay é enjoativa e repetitiva, os inimigos possuem uma inteligencia artificial bizarramente burra. Eu só dou negativo para um jogo que eu não consiga nem sequer chegar no seu final, o que nao foi o caso, eu zerei o Far Cry 5 com 25.7 horas mas na força do ódio... A match-3 type budget puzzle game with some lewd anime girls. Developers also added some story to the pictures so it's worth it, right?  The puzzle part is pretty standard. Several different symbols (or panties with the patch) to match by swapping neighbouring ones. You have a limited time to reach certain score. Higher stages require more points to complete. A few different special skills when you match more than 3 balls make it easy to complete any stage. Very casual difficulty. Three different stages per girl, five different girls. Each stage has a brief, badly translated story before and after it. For the price asked it is a pretty decent puzzle but there is nothing innovative when compared to similar titles.  The character art is good. Nice amount of detail and lewdness. All characters are animated and offer three stages of undress. Every girl has two animated scenes with some interaction choices. Animation loops are rather simple, though, still slightly above average at this price level. Overall design is pretty good too.  Music is fine. Nothing memorable and not much variety, but good enough.   No bugs encountered but two of the achievements are most likely bugged. I've spent way more time then intended, and earned more than 7500% on each girl to confidently say so. In my estimation I did more than 11000 matches so yeah, don't waste your time on try to get 5000, 10000 eliminate achievements.  To summarise, a pretty basic match-3 puzzle with a good, decently animated art and an ok music. For the price asked I can easily recommend: 5.7/10

The 2nd 69 title produced by Loolust. Is Yuki better than Cindy? More enticing?   This 'sequel' is, for the most part, the same as the previous one - a jigsaw puzzle. There are no new features or difficulty settings. Still using the same, simple drag and drop mechanic to complete the ecchi pictures. There are now 16 stages, which is 2 more than the previous part. However, unlike the 'prequel', now there is no linear progression of difficulty. Every 4 stages, or picture change, the number of pieces decreases limiting the challenge quite a bit. Now the final stages are much quicker than previously, so the game's length is actually shorter. Still, I don't see it as a flaw but design choice. It's good to see some effort to change rather than just straight copying like many devs do. Also, the price asked is the same so if you liked the previous one or just enjoy similar games then it might be worth trying.  The anime art has slightly improved over the predecessor but not by much. Still average amount of details and cartoonish feel but it looks more attractive to me now. Also, there is a very simple idle movement animation increasing attractiveness somewhat. This sure counts as improvement.  Music is fine. Simple relaxing track playing in the background works well. Nothing noticeable but it doesn't have to be. Lack of variety is more or less justified by how short the title is.  No bugs encountered.  To summarise, 69 Yuki is a slightly improved 'sequel' with more but easier stages and simple, idle animations of Yuki + simple, calm music. Despite some effort to improve the price stayed the same. If you you like this sort of titles then this one is ok to try: 4.5/10

I have put way more time into DayZ on the PS4, than on the PC, but I can say that they are both practically the same, except for the obvious fact that on PC you get mods. But that doesn't change the typical PVP experience.  I won't reiterate what others have said. What I will say is that, if you are like me, and are sensitive to stress and get *really* immersed in your games, then you might find yourself incredibly stressed out while playing DayZ, as in my position I feel like I can never relax when in the game, and that there's no good place to stop and stretch my real life legs. I have some very bad experiences with this game, full of significant undesirable stress.   If you are looking to kill some time-- this however is the right game for you. Most of the game is spent walking from point A to B, and while I think this is purely just bad game design (it's easily 90% of the game so much so that custom servers usually have an autorun option), it is GREAT for killing time.   If you wanna waste some time having a varying degree of fun, but a definite unique experience, play DayZ. If you aren't an adrenaline junkie who likes the thrill of this type of game, I advise to avoid it. There are plenty of other games out there. Though if you are forced to pick DayZ, I can say that you will leave with mixed feelings; as most players do.

I give this game a good review, because I like the story and the atmosphere a lot and the way it is visualized is really cool, but there are some big flaws that made the game really frustrating to some degree:   My game as a whole was bugged. There is that mechanic, where you can see the detection from enemies, if they spot you and such, but it wasn't there at my playthrough on survival. Also the PC controlls are a bit janky and unintuitiv, so it was a pain in the ass to switch weapons and switch between the crossbow arrows. Many hitboxes in the game are trash and hit you nonetheless, that was especially painful at one boss, where he could dash in a really big parking lot area, you could turn around a corner and still hit you.  The story is quite complex and fully understandable after you complete the game and for me the last scene was bugged and it cutted to the credits too early, so I was left confused until I watched a video on YouTube, which explained the ending and then I watched the ending as a whole on youtube again.   Gameplay-wise you have the choice between stealth and gun. For me the stealth was introduced in the tutorial and didn't come again in any of the chapters afterwards and stayed optional, but I played very loud so it may be because of this and my bigger problem was the ammo, which was very limited from time to time until at one point I had nothing left and decided to just run through, so I guess the combat can be quite diverse, but from what I saw stealth isn't very fun to do, because you basically wait for the enemy to turn around and this can make a 2 minute area into 8 minute long one.   In conclusion: The game is great and I want to play the DLCs and the second game, but maybe my experience would have been better if I played on Playstation or something, because it feels like the game got a poor port when getting on PC

A Mortician's Tale is a somber look into the funeral home industry. It's not so much a game as it is a work of interactive fiction. There is gameplay in preparing the bodies for viewings or cremation, but it's mostly about the story of how funeral parlors are run, and the negative effects that mega corporations of the death industry have on them.  If you've ever been curious about a mortician's work and don't mind reading through emails, then I'd suggest giving the game a try, it does manage to elicit a range of emotions and because it is short, the gameplay doesn't feel overly repetitive.  But buy it in a bundle—unless you just really want to fund the devs—because it IS a short game. Playing through it leisurely it only took a little over an hour and a half to complete.

Its a fun game but not very good. The UI is abysmal and very clunky with multiple things to click through just to select a scope. Specialists are interesting but the old 4 classic classes were more fun and gave more variety as there were more options for gadgets for each class now they are all crammed trying to encompass all classes with 8 gadgets. One free fire rocket launcher and one anti air rocket launcher but no variety like in past battlefields with laser guided or ground lock on. This is supposed to be 2042 idk why we are shooting a free fire rocket launcher that gives you three shots that might not kill a tank if all three hit, seems silly. The attachments of guns is interesting as there is less customization that there was in battlefield 4 and some guns seem to have less attachments offered when in the same class. The second unlockable LMG has like one underbarrel attachment and far fewer other customizable options when the one before has many many more options. I am sure they will add more guns but I think the attachments and stuff should be more meaningful or feel better, the bipod on the LMGs dont feel like they work much at all, maps are so large shotguns are hard to level, a couple guns dominate the meta like PP-19 whatever, SVK, ect. Vehicles are atrocious, never have i been afraid of a ground transport vehicle in any other battlefield game until now. Hovercraft if a roomba of death and it is difficult to shoot the drivers and gunners in them and there are few options to take these vehicles out. And the game is super buggy, there are very few gamemodes to even play in battlefield 2042, conquest, breakthrough (similar to rush or operations), and extraction which is like a pvpve battleroyale ish thing. No small maps essentially, everything is on such a large scale so you cant hop into a quick team deathmatch just to play for kills and level, it has to be on these huge maps were you spend a good majority running or having to use guns to fight in large spaces when traversing the maps. The maps are okay, i dont like any of them particularly and they dont have any features in them that make them that memorable or that next level. Some of them have a bit too much empty space and there is like no maps that have urban combat like with multiple buildings with multiple places to go into or any settings like that. Some have small areas like this but i miss the old maps like pearl market or siene crossing or anything in the aftermath dlcs. Then there is battlefield portal which is cool and nostalgic but few maps, few gamemodes, and few old school guns and vehicles. Its just enough to make it fun and nostalgic but not enough to fully enjoy these old schools games for what they were, just gives you a little taste. My hopes are that in a couple months down the line, the game will be in a much better state but honestly at the moment its not great, I am having fun playing it but it needs a lot a lot of work. Amazing too that this game doesnt even have a campaign to focus more on their multiplayer and its in such a poor state. Stop releasing half complete games and trying to update as it goes on, shouldnt be happening for any studios let alone a AAA studio. So sad

A word of warning it does start of very slow, the initial missions you don't feel free at all but when that snow goes the game really begins and you won't look back. I've played some open world games in my time, but this one takes the CAKE! First of all, it is visually encapsulating and atmospheric with amazingly complimentary ambiance and a decently vast world to explore. Second, the combat/travel mechanics are challenging, sure, but ENGAGING! Which is MEGA important in ANY game. The combat flow is dynamic with each new enemy and there's always a variety of approaches you can take with any given scenario, which is amazing! Third and final, (and I probably should've started with this), THE STORY AND PLOT DEVELOPMENT IS SUPERBLY WELL-DONE! I'm talking, this game pulls you in within the first TWO MINUTES and piques your curiosity, making you want to explore more!   All that being said, while it IS a phenomenal title to go along with the open-world RPG genre of games, I do have some issues with the game. They're not THAT bad, but for me they were quite infuriating (putting it lightly). There are some equipment pieces that to some of the community are claimed as the best. As soon as you go above normal difficulty, this is SWIFTLY proven wrong so the harder difficulties you attempt, the more tactility you will need (a lot more than dodge rolls unfortunately). This issue is why I certainly will NOT be attempting the game on ULTRA HARD because I play to enjoy, not stress myself out.  Regardless, If you enjoy sci-fi, open-world, stone-age-style combat, stealth games, etc. I highly recommend Horizon Zero Dawn.

Llevar nuevamente al fuego y cuando se nota que los bordes del panqueque comienzan a dorar y despegar de los bordes, se da vuelta con ayuda de una espátula o cuchillo dejándolo cocinar 1 o 2 minutos más. Uno por uno con el mismo procedimiento terminar con el resto de los panqueques. A medida que se van haciendo se colocan encimados cubiertos con un plato para que se mantengan calentitos y no se sequen. Te los recomiendo con dulce de leche mmmm... mis favoritos !!!!!

[h3]A dream comes true... which we owe to the developers of [i]Weaving Tides[/i]![/h3]  I backed the Kickstarter, already played the prologue and the beta demo for many hours, and now its final release - and I'm delighted!  This game brings a completely new technique and approach to gameplay, that is absolutely fun, but often requires a change in thinking! Whether it's the style of defeating enemies, solving clever puzzles or discovering secrets or the very well thought out equipment - everything is just so nicely put into the shape of textile and fabrics and the woven world!  The puzzles are sometimes a bit difficult to crack, but never unfair, there is always a clue (which often has to be discovered first). All the more rewarding!  The design is absolutely charming and rich in detail. The setting, the colors and its wonderful soundtrack invite you to sink into the game and lose yourself in it. Although it has a very relaxing atmosphere, there are definitely puzzles that challenge and enemies that bring in a bit of action.  [code][i]I immediately fell in love with the graphic style - and that's why I nominated it for the 'outstanding visual style' category at the Steam Awards without hesitation![/i][/code]  Its charming and witty dialogues make you sympathize, but most of all, they often made me laugh! The avatars are incredibly beautiful. This was written and drawn with passion from the heart.  And then there are the carpet dragons, which also fit so wonderfully into this fantasy world! (The older ones might remember the never-ending story where a boy got to ride a friendly dragon - and who among us wouldn't have wanted to! And even pet it!)  The controls feel very pleasant and direct, and are brought closer to the player one by one. All elements are implemented intuitively, there is no need for a tutorial, you just step right into the adventure - even the techniques, which then need to be used later on, and get increasingly difficult and more and more complex.  In the course of the adventure, you collect more and more ribbons, which then you can use in Weaving Tides' Playgrounds mode. This creative mode offers many ways to creatively express yourself at a fun time, but also has the potential to keep the community active and staying together! The creative spirit slumbering in each of us wants to be awakened!  [h3]What else could I say?[/h3] I like it so much, I'm already on my third adventure playthrough and it won't be my last and hopefully I will be sharing some Playgrounds creations here on Steam soon! I will definitely get the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1075170/Weaving_Tides/]soundtrack[/url] and I want to play this on Nintendo Switch as well!!  [i]Although the following isn't a game-related review, this only makes the game better and more endearing:[/i]  The devs are very caring, transparent and open-hearted with their community and that's why it's not surprising they managed to gather such a wonderful community around them, that supports each other. Most importantly, they listen to their community and go to great lengths to ensure giving the game the polish and finishing touches it deserves!  Considering the complexity of game development and that the devs consist of just 4 people who have worked hard for years to give us this pleasure, shows this isn't only a true masterpiece, but with this innovative appearance an absolute blessing for the games industry!  As enchanting and relaxing - the devs of [i]Weaving Tides[/i] also make their previous project [i]NIVA[/i] available on [url=https://followfeathers.itch.io/niva]itch.io[/url] in return for a donation of your choice.  People who give us such beautiful games need to be supported!

[長文慎入]    今日有款遊戲想介紹下，呢款遊戲就係由Avalanche Software所開發，以哈利波特魔法為背景，一款開放世界動作角色扮演遊戲，「霍格華兹的傳承」。作為一個鍾意哈利波特電影系列嘅玩家，當初公開霍格華兹消息嘅時候，見倒遊戲咁豐富嘅玩法，加上咁吸引嘅世界觀，都令我好有意欲去體驗呢款遊戲，等咗咁耐終於推出啦，緊係要盡快買嚟體驗下啦。    玩完之後，呢款遊戲真係幾正，遊戲表現令我相當驚喜，不論劇情定角色都幾吸引，戰鬥系統易上手幾有趣。可以使用嘅咒語唔算多，但都幾忠於原着，幾好玩。地圖設計有心思、有誠意，解謎部分都唔錯，而配樂都幾好聽，美術風格幾靚，呢款遊戲嘅整體表現我都好滿意。      咁首先等我介紹下呢款遊戲嘅劇情啦，呢款遊戲就發生喺1890年(哈利波特正傳百幾年之前)，玩家將會扮演天賦異稟，識得古代魔法嘅霍格華茲學院五年級插班生，玩家所嚟扮演嘅主角，可以隨意喺呢個魔法世界自由探索，學習各種咒語，收服各種奇獸，解決唔同角色嘅疑難，除此之外，喺呢段旅程玩家仲要對抗唔同嘅黑巫師，以及要瓦解邪惡勢力嘅陰謀，咁到底主角喺呢段旅程會遇到咩事？古代魔法隱藏住咩秘密？呢個魔法世界嘅命運又會點？如有興趣就可以自己買嚟體驗下啦。呢款遊戲嘅劇本原作者JK羅琳並冇參與，加上遊戲亦冇好出乎意料嘅劇情發展，所以遊戲劇本對比小說或者電影情節明顯係顯得有啲平淡，不過當玩家接觸倒呢個帶點熟悉感又未知嘅魔法世界，相信都會同我一樣，好快就會沉浸喺呢個世界觀當中，或許遊戲劇情發展都係好典型嘅套路(主角係天選之人，學習各種魔法，阻止邪惡反派陰謀)，但遊戲咁吸引嘅世界觀同埋各種華麗嘅魔法，都令我好想知劇情嘅發展，以及呢個魔法世界嘅命運。除咗主線故事之外，三位主要配角嘅支線故事都唔錯，感覺幾有趣(尤其係賽巴斯蒂安嘅故事線，我覺得仲精彩過主線故事)。呢款遊戲嘅世界觀亦相當吸引，玩家除咗可以喺主線同埋支線，了解返原着百幾年之前樣貌，仲可以透過各種嘅收集物品，加深了解返呢個世界觀嘅歷史。    由於呢款遊戲就發生喺1890年，大家所熟知嘅角色(例如哈利波特、阿不思鄧不利多)都未出世，所以喺呢款遊戲入面，大部份原作嘅角色都冇登場，不過並唔代表呢款遊戲角色，同正傳嘅角色冇任何關連，遊戲部分角色嘅祖先都有登場，例如霍格華茲校長就係天狼星嘅太爺、副校長係衛斯理家族成員， 而原作部份嘅幽靈喺呢款遊戲都有登場，呢個安排下令到本作雖然同原作嘅年代有啲距離，不過都增添返啲關聯性，圍繞住主角身邊嘅角色，都係原著中大家熟悉嘅姓氏，呢點令到有接觸過原著嘅玩家，有返啲嘅熟悉感。    而家等我介紹下呢款遊戲玩法啦，由於玩家所扮演嘅主角係霍格華兹嘅學生，所以遊戲中大部分嘅時間都會喺霍格華兹度過，玩家更需要喺呢間魔法學院學習，透過修讀各種耳熟能詳嘅學科(例如魔藥學、黑魔法防禦術)，嚟學習各種咒語，而部分課堂上冇教嘅咒語，就要完成唔同教授交低嘅任務，先會傳受俾主角，呢款遊戲以魔法題材遊戲嚟講，咒語真係相對比較少，不過唔少咒語都還原倒原著嘅精髓，唔少咒語都好有用，對戰鬥同埋解迷都有好大幫助。而遊戲中後期開始，玩家就會有屬於自己嘅獨立空間「萬應室」，喺萬應室入面，玩家可以種植各種對戰鬥有利嘅植物，調配各種有輔助效果嘅魔藥，仲可以飼養從唔同地方收服嘅奇獸，萬應室呢個部分我都幾鍾意，俾玩家除咗育成主角之外，仲有更多嘅育成部分，萬應室呢個部分仲有少少似動森，感覺都幾有趣。呢款遊戲旅途嘅過程中，玩家需要對付唔同嘅黑巫師以及魔法生物，同唔同嘅敵人戰鬥，呢款遊戲戰鬥系統感覺都唔錯，對比其他動作遊戲，玩落就冇咁複雜，幾易上手，呢款遊戲戰鬥嘅時候，玩家可以用魔杖對敵人使出普通攻擊，當面對敵人攻擊嘅時候，玩家可以使用翻滾避開敵人嘅攻擊，或者使用破心護格檔敵人嘅攻擊，而喺合適時機使用破心護，更可以直接將敵人嘅攻擊反彈。雖然隨住主角變強，敵人都會變強，不過由於主角可以學倒各種強勁嘅咒語(不赦咒真係好好用)，加上當玩家熟悉各種咒語，戰鬥上就會輕鬆咗，面對強大嘅敵人都會冇乜威脅性。呢款遊戲戰鬥系統嘅打擊感，坦白講其實就一般般，不過戰鬥嘅時候，可以使用小說同埋電影出現過嘅咒語，感覺真係好過癮。呢款遊戲除咗戰鬥之外，仲有唔少解謎元素，呢款遊戲解謎嘅難度都唔算好高，唔同嘅謎題都要使用嘅對應咒語，先可以解決到，呢款遊戲解謎嘅部份我覺得都幾有趣，但係解謎嘅咒語只係局限於幾個，而遊戲大部份這咒語都冇運用落解謎倒，呢點就有啲可惜。    呢款遊戲嘅美術風格我都幾鍾意，呢款遊戲既然以霍格華茲的傳承為遊戲命名，咁霍格華兹呢間魔法學院當然就係遊戲重點啦，相信有唔少粉絲同我一樣都曾經有諗過，想親身遊覽一次霍格華兹，而呢款遊戲總算可以還一眾粉絲嘅心願啦。遊戲當中嘅霍格華兹相當之大，就算無接觸過原作嘅玩家，見到呢座咁古老嘅魔法城堡，應該都會同我一樣咁震撼。霍格華兹呢張地圖真係整得好有心思，唔少嘅細節還原度都好高，完美將小說或者電影中霍格華兹嘅形象呈現。除咗霍格華兹之外，玩家仲可以遊覽原著中嘅著名景點(例如活米村，不過要留意返原著中部份嘅景點要100年前都存在，玩家先會見到)，地圖總有唔少嘅彩蛋等著玩家去發掘。呢款遊戲配樂都幾好聽，聽住呢啲帶有熟悉感嘅配樂，配搭咁奇幻嘅世界，真係好營造倒嗰種魔幻感。    呢款遊戲各方面我覺得都幾優秀，地圖設計出色，玩法又咁豐富，但遊戲免不了係有啲明顯嘅缺憾(例如主角模組都唔錯，但玩家設計主角外貌嘅自由度就比較細、對話選項都幾多，但對劇情走向並無影響、魁地奇比賽取消咗)，呢啲部份都比較可惜，不過基於從各方面都感受到製作團隊嘅誠意，以及對呢個魔法世界熱愛，就足以彌補倒呢款遊戲比較明顯嘅缺憾。    總括嚟講，呢款遊戲真係幾正，不論劇情定角色都幾吸引，戰鬥系統易上手幾有趣。可以使用嘅咒語唔算多，但都幾忠於原着，幾好玩。地圖設計有心思、有誠意，解謎部分都唔錯，而配樂都幾好聽，美術風格幾靚。呢款遊戲我都幾推薦，有接觸過原著小說或者電影嘅玩家，好值得入手細味呢款遊戲。

结束第一场场旅程时我有点恍惚，待我清醒过来，立刻来写了这份评论。 相较于游戏我更愿称之为艺术。  在看过许多游戏博主的推荐后我买下了这份游戏，他们口中的旅伴风景与冒险很吸引我，但游玩过后我发现远远不止这些，且内容更加震撼我。  与陌生的旅人相遇在桥下，在海底你被龙夺取了两次围巾，但相互扶持下还是来到了雪山，我以为这份情谊会伴我走到最后，落后时我会停下来等你，暴风时两人相互扶持，有一位志同道合的朋友多好，但很可惜，你在雪山的狭缝中坐化了，我当时并不知道怎么办才好，最后只能硬着头皮向前走，最后在暴风雪中倒下。  旅途结束后画面的第一座墓碑，我不知道是不是我的，路途中的墓碑我也不知道是不是其他旅人的，甚至那些是不是墓碑我都不知道。流星滑过的画面那几位旅人是不是在等待着谁我不知道，起点的两个围巾是不是我与旅人的我也不知道。但这又如何呢？我感慨沙漠中的风沙与神殿，诧异在海底出现的巨龙和遗迹，同样惊叹于温暖的通天塔及活泼的精灵......路途中走过的太多太多都值得我无限回味。  回到起点时我呆呆的，回想起这一路我都遇到了些什么，虽不至于让我热泪盈眶，但也让我的内心五味杂陈。配着舒缓旷达的音乐，我回到了最初的两条围巾旁。  谢谢你，陌生的旅人，陪我走过这段路程。

我目前刚刚通关致远星，战斗进化，光环2，光环三也开始打了。接下来的评测主要讲讲我对光环最经典的一部：战斗进化一些问题可能与常人不同的一些看法。  致远星非常好玩，这也导致我对第一部也就是战斗进化期待过高。  战斗进化和第二部在士官长合集中都是重制版，画质有质的飞跃，在游戏里按tab可以随时在原来的画质和重制版的画质之间切换。但是即便是重制版画面也称不上完美，且不说画面精细程度，学过美术的都知道明暗分界线这个概念，而光环1,2的画面就是典型的没有明暗分界线，说的不好听点目光所及画面都是一个sai的，没有明暗对比带来的视觉冲击，再加上本来场景就单调，很容易就会看腻。增强对比度的话画面建模啥的又会有失真，建议改进一下。  再来谈谈游戏性。光环1的游戏性我觉得几乎可以让我打差评，但是光环2有明显改善所以我还是冷静了下来。光环1是明显的高开低走，前面的剧情密度明显要比后面的大，游戏后期几乎就是打怪打怪打怪打怪，而且他还不是说给你一些很难的怪，游戏前期遇到啥后期遇到的还是啥，能够称之为boss的就是有猎人了。除开猎人它增加游戏后期难度的方式就是吧怪的数量调的贼jb大，只要苟着打不可能打不过，但是也正因为此再加上场景单调难免会让人产生厌烦。  战斗进化还有一大问题就是极其容易迷路。场景本身就单调没有特征来让人判断方向容易迷路，还几乎不给你指出来应该往哪走，全靠你自己摸索，再加上没有疾跑系统玩家移动速度慢地图尺寸大还大多是密闭的非常让人崩溃，承受能力差点的憋出来幽闭恐惧症都不是不可能。还有就是战斗进化你进入到游戏中后期基本上不可能有友军，1v1亿，打的还是洪魔，说白了就是丧尸这种令人作呕的东西，实在是很让人烦躁。  总而言之战斗进化你玩到觉得无聊的时候就可以上网去搜后面的剧情然后直接开始第二部了，因为后期的剧情基本上就是没有剧情，就像我说的，游戏内容就是打怪打怪打怪打怪，非常无聊，还容易迷路。

The story line is great with lots of dialog options that keep the banter between characters and missions exciting and actually makes you feel like a part of the whole city and story as opposed to just wandering and the story happening TO you. If you like RPG's and looter shooters with a ton of open world that will not make you feel cramped then this game is definitely for you. Fore warning though, this game IS NOT INTENDED FOR YOUNGER AUDIENCES!!! DO NOT AND I REPEAT DO NOT PLAY AROUND CHILDREN. This game is certainly made for adult players that are not easily offended. I would definitely recommend this game for someone looking to get lost in a great story and amazing beautifully designed world.

总体评价：h略微简单，玩法单一，但好玩，尤其是种地和交易系统很有意思，缺点很明显，h方面是动态cg，很用心了，可只有一些简单的重复动作，很无语。然后系统上他有h系统和交易种植系统很有意思，但是缺乏战斗系统和智力系统，没智力系统玩的就很单调。甚至会困，所以我提出以下建议。 1.添加食品/料理系统   食物全是原味的不能搞个食谱吗，自己做菜，如果不合常理就做出废物，合常理的食物不同的火候可以有不同的回复效果甚至可以加一些buff，比如加快砍伐挖矿战斗力度，在里面加智力系统，卡火候，通过完美按键做出完美食物，做够3+就可以不用按键直接做出. 2.人设和剧情拓展        玩的时候感觉这个游戏人设没那么强，寡妇房子细节应该是温良的青年女性，但是剧情搞得好像拿我当工具人的性奴，拓展一个战斗系统，密林里加入野兽然后寡妇去采煲汤的料的时候遇到袭击偶然逃脱，邀请我去，发生搏斗领取悬赏，然后感情升温，一起煲汤一起生活，还有为什么我不能在别人家睡觉，拓展不行吗，在这还能加很多剧情，考虑到工作人员很少很辛苦，至少来个预告或者计划也行啊。h人物其实没必要太多只要人设精良就行了. 3.人物角色太缺导致地图太空  后山肯定会有别人，有种地系统为什么不加个建造系统，给人建房子然后人口增多，不用有建模，只是来个黑脸的男造型或者女造型就可，我也感觉有一种做村长的成就感。 4.npc啥也不会     明明很多npc有专属技能，梅婆做菜，这就需要料理系统，还能拓展一个人物的剧情，寡妇可以帮着纺线，拿去卖，这么多npc但是没一个有用. 5. 拓展地图  地图太小了，玩法自然少了 6. 职业系统为什么我啥也不是，搞个职业系统不香吗 虽然玩法少但是这个游戏很推荐.

Hello Neighbor to gra, która miała potencjał, ale niestety nie udało jej się go wykorzystać. Założenie jest proste: gracz wciela się w chłopca, który chce dowiedzieć się, co jego sąsiad ukrywa w tajemniczej piwnicy. Aby to zrobić, musi skradać się po jego domu i unikać wykrycia.  W teorii to brzmi interesująco, ale w praktyce gra jest pełna wad. Po pierwsze, rozgrywka jest powtarzalna i nużąca. W zasadzie polega ona na tym samym: zbieraniu kluczy, unikaniu sąsiada i wchodzeniu do nowych pomieszczeń. Po drugie, gra jest pełna błędów i glitchy. To często prowadzi do frustracji i psuje zabawę. Po trzecie, historia jest płytka i nieciekawa. (O ile ta historia w ogóle istnieje)  Jedynym elementem, który można pochwalić, jest trailer Trailery miały dość ciekawą estetykę i dobrze zapowiadały grę.  Podsumowując, Hello Neighbor to gra, której nie polecam. Jest ona niedopracowana, pełna błędów i nużąca. Jeśli szukasz dobrej gry skradankowej i połączonej z horrorem, lepiej poszukaj czegoś innego.  Ocena: 2/10  *Negatywne aspekty gry:  * Powtarzalna i nużąca rozgrywka * Pełna błędów i glitchy * Płytka i nieciekawa historia (prawie w ogóle jej NIE MA) * Gra ewoluowała z horroru  w straszaka dla dzieci * Fabuła pełna dziur i nielogiczności * Zagadki nie mają sensu * Gra ma więcej bugów niż alphy  **Dodatkowe uwagi:**  Gra została zapowiedziana jako dobry horror, ale w rzeczywistości jest to straszak dla dzieci. Pierwsze alphy były bardziej przerażające i miały bardziej dojrzałą historię a raczej poszlaki wskazywały na dojrzałą historię... Z czasem gra ewoluowała w kierunku, który nie jest interesujący dla starszych graczy.  Fabuła gry jest bardzo płytka i pełna dziur. Nie ma żadnego sensownego wyjaśnienia, dlaczego sąsiad jest taki dziwny i dlaczego chowa w piwnicy tajemnice. Zagadki również są nielogiczne i często nie mają sensu. **WIEM, ZE ISTNIEJE HELLO NEIGHBOR HIDE AND SEEK ALE TO ZOSTAŁO ZROBIONE I WYMYŚLONE NA SIŁĘ POD WPŁYWEM NACISKU GRACZY**  Gra ma więcej bugów niż alpy. Mimo wielu poprawek, które zostały wprowadzone po premierze, gra nadal jest pełna błędów, które mogą psuć zabawę.  Podsumowując, Hello Neighbor to gra, która jest dużym rozczarowaniem. Gierka miała potencjał, ale niestety został on zmarnowany.

Pros:  Realistic Culinary Experience: Cooking Simulator provides a detailed and immersive cooking experience. Players learn precise measurements, temperature control, and ingredient usage, making it feel like a real kitchen.  Multiple Game Modes: The game offers various modes, including a tutorial, career mode, and sandbox mode. Challenging Controls: While it may take time to get used to the controls, they add depth to the gameplay. Players need to handle utensils and ingredients with precision, which enhances the sense of realism.  Perks and Progression: Career mode introduces perks that enhance gameplay, offering advantages like faster movement and improved food handling. This adds an element of progression to the game.  Realism in Cooking: Cooking Simulator excels in replicating real-life cooking processes, such as controlling heat and measurements, which directly impact the quality of the dishes.  Inclusion of Music: The availability of a radio with multiple stations adds a personal touch to the game, allowing players to enjoy music while they cook.  Cons:  Control Learning Curve: The controls, especially when using utensils, may be challenging initially and require some patience to master.  Occasional Frame Rate Drops: Some players have experienced frame rate drops when the screen becomes crowded, which can affect the overall gaming experience.  Conclusion:  Cooking Simulator lives up to its name by delivering a highly detailed and realistic culinary experience. It offers various game modes to cater to different playstyles, and the inclusion of perks in career mode adds depth to gameplay. While the controls may take time to get used to, they contribute to the game's sense of realism. Despite occasional frame rate issues, Cooking Simulator is an excellent choice for both newcomers to simulation games and seasoned players looking for a true-to-life cooking experience.
